*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
INITIALIZATION.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
* 회사코드 기본 세팅(프로젝트 투입시 변경 필요)                                 
  PERFORM SET_BUKRS USING SY-TCODE
                 CHANGING P_BUKRS.
  PERFORM SET_LAYOUTA    CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
  P_BNAME = SY-UNAME.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF SCREEN-NAME = 'P_BUKRS'.
      SCREEN-INPUT = 0.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nbs
AT SELECTION-SCREEN.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nbs
  SELECT SINGLE *
           FROM ZFBT025
          WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
            AND UNAME = SY-UNAME.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    GV_AUTH = SPACE.
  ELSE.
    GV_AUTH = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON VALUE-REQUEST FOR P_BANK-LOW.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nbs
  PERFORM F4_BANK USING P_BANK-LOW 'P_BANK-LOW'.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON VALUE-REQUEST FOR P_BANK-HIGH.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nbs
  PERFORM F4_BANK USING P_BANK-LOW 'P_BANK-HIGH'.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nbs
START-OF-SELECTION.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
  PERFORM GET_DATA_DB_FROM.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
END-OF-SELECTION.

  IF G_HCNT = 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '해당 DATA가 없습니다.'.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM : ALVPRN_BASIC,
              ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
              ALVPRN_FIELD,
              ALV_DISPLAY.
  ENDIF.

*&------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
*&      Form  USER_COMMAND                               &nb
*&------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
FORM USER_COMMAND USING  P_UCOMM    LIKE SY-UCOMM
                         P_SELFIELD TYPE SLIS_SELFIELD.

  CASE P_UCOMM.
    WHEN '&IC1'.        "더블클릭 이벤트 처리.
      PERFORM DB_CLICK USING P_SELFIELD.

    WHEN 'RFSH'.        "리플레쉬
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'UPDT'.         "수작업전표 입력      * GUI에서 제외됨
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_UPDATE.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'DOCU'.         "입금전표
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_CREA.
*      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT.                              &nbs
*      PERFORM CLEARING_DOCUMENT1.                               
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'DOCUCN'.         "입금전표취소
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_CANCEL.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'DISC'.           "어음할인처리
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_DISC.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[].
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH = 'X'.

    WHEN 'POST'.         "만기전표
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_POST.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'POSTCN'.         "만기전표취소
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_POST_CANCEL.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'FEE'.
      PERFORM SET_FEE_AMT.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'TEXT'.     "텍스트 입력
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_TEXT.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'CUST'.     "거래처입력
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'BILL'.
      PERFORM CHANGE_BILL_DATE.
      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

*    WHEN 'E_DOCU'.           "기타반제처리                       
*      PERFORM ETC_CREATE_DOCU.                               &nb
*      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.                         &nbs
*      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.                               &nbs
*      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.                                &
*      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.                             
*      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.                              &nbs
*      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],                        &
*                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.                   &n
*      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.                              
*      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.                              
*      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.                           &nb
*                                          &n
*    WHEN 'L_DOCU'.           "기타GL처리                       
*      PERFORM GLC_CREATE_DOCU.                               &nb
*      CLEAR   IT_0102.  REFRESH IT_0102.                         &nbs
*      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.                               &nbs
*      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.                                &
*      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.                             
*      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.                              &nbs
*      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],                        &
*                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.                   &n
*      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.                              
*      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.                              
*      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.                           &nb

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                    "USER_COMMAND
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0200  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0200 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0200_OK'.
      UPDATE ZFBT102 SET ZTEXT100  = G_TEXT
                   WHERE ZBUKR     = P_BUKRS
                     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        MESSAGE S000 WITH '저장되었습니다.'.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

    WHEN '0200_CN'.
      CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0200  INPUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  ALVPRN_HEADER                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       TOP PAGE ITEM WRITE                             &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM ALVPRN_HEADER  USING    P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T TYPE
                             SLIS_T_LISTHEADER.

  DATA: L_LINE_S TYPE SLIS_LISTHEADER,
        L_INFO   TYPE SLIS_LISTHEADER-INFO,
        L_TEXT   LIKE T001-BUTXT.
  DATA : LV_TEXT(30) TYPE C.

  SELECT SINGLE BUTXT
    INTO L_TEXT
    FROM T001
   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'H'.
  PERFORM ALV_HEADER_PROGRAM_NAME
    USING SY-REPID L_LINE_S-INFO.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  CONCATENATE P_BUKRS L_TEXT INTO L_INFO SEPARATED BY' '.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'S'.
  L_LINE_S-KEY  = '회사코드 :'.
  WRITE L_INFO TO L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-INFO = L_INFO.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO, LV_TEXT.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'S'.
  L_LINE_S-KEY  = '조회일자 :'.
  IF P_RDATE-HIGH IS NOT INITIAL.
    WRITE : P_RDATE-LOW  TO L_LINE_S-INFO,
            P_RDATE-HIGH TO LV_TEXT.
    CONCATENATE L_LINE_S-INFO '~' LV_TEXT
           INTO L_LINE_S-INFO SEPARATED BY SPACE.
  ELSE.
    WRITE : P_RDATE-LOW  TO L_LINE_S-INFO.
  ENDIF.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'H'.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

ENDFORM.                    " ALVPRN_HEADER

  CS_LAYO-DETAIL_TITLEBAR        = SPACE.
*... PF-status                                       &n
  CS_LAYO-DEF_STATUS             = SPACE.
*... Display variants                                     &n
  CS_LAYO-HEADER_TEXT            = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-ITEM_TEXT              = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-DEFAULT_ITEM           = SPACE.
*... colour                                        
  CS_LAYO-INFO_FIELDNAME         = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-COLTAB_FIELDNAME       = SPACE.
*... others                                        
  CS_LAYO-LIST_APPEND            = SPACE.

ENDFORM.                    " set_layouta
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SELECT_ZFBT102                               &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SELECT_ZFBT102 .

  CASE 'X'.
    WHEN P_RAD1.
*   발행일자 기준                                     &n
      SELECT *
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_0102
        FROM ZFBT102
       WHERE ZBUKR         =  P_BUKRS
         AND ( ( DOCU_CODE = '4000' AND UPMU_CODE = '501' ) OR
               ( DOCU_CODE = '4100' AND UPMU_CODE = '601' ) )
         AND BANK_CODE1   IN P_BANK
         AND TRNDT        IN P_RDATE
         AND KUNNR        IN S_KUNNR
         AND STCD2        IN S_STCD2.
*         AND TRGUBN       IN ('11', '21', '31', '32').                
    WHEN P_RAD2.
*   만기일자 기준                                     &n
      SELECT *
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_0102
        FROM ZFBT102
       WHERE ZBUKR         =  P_BUKRS
         AND ( ( DOCU_CODE = '4000' AND UPMU_CODE = '501' ) OR
               ( DOCU_CODE = '4100' AND UPMU_CODE = '601' ) )
         AND BANK_CODE1   IN P_BANK
         AND TRIDT        IN P_RDATE
         AND KUNNR        IN S_KUNNR
         AND STCD2        IN S_STCD2.
*         AND TRGUBN       IN ('11', '21', '31', '32').                
  ENDCASE.

*  "회사별 부서코드 정의                                    &nbs
*  PERFORM SET_KOSTL(ZFBR655) USING P_BUKRS GV_KOSTL.                            &nbs

ENDFORM.                    " SELECT_ZFBT102
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  modify_data                               &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM MODIFY_DATA .

  DATA : LT_0102 LIKE ZFBT102 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : LV_AMT  LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.

  DATA : L_0102_T LIKE IT_0102 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.
*  DATA : LT_0210 LIKE ZFBT210 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                        
  DATA : L_AMT   LIKE BSEG-WRBTR.

  RANGES : R_KUNNR FOR KNA1-KUNNR.

  DATA IDX LIKE SY-TABIX.

  LOOP AT IT_0102.
    CLEAR IDX. IDX = SY-TABIX.

    CLEAR LT_0102. REFRESH LT_0102.
    IF IT_0102-PART_GUBN = SPACE.
      SELECT *
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_0102
        FROM ZFBT102
       WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
         AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
         AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
         AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
         AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
         AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
         AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
         AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO.
*         AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.                           &nb

*      IF IT_0102-BELNR_B = SPACE.                             &n
      CLEAR LV_AMT.
      LOOP AT LT_0102.
        LV_AMT = LV_AMT + LT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      ENDLOOP.

      IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT - LV_AMT.
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
    ELSE.
      IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
    ENDIF.

    IF IT_0102-SYMBL   = '-'.
      IT_0102-BLNC_AMT = IT_0102-BLNC_AMT * -1 .
    ENDIF.
*   은행명                                       
    SELECT SINGLE TEXT FROM ZFBT056 INTO IT_0102-TEXT
                      WHERE BANK_CODE1 = IT_0102-BANK_CODE1.
*   거래처명                                      &nbs
    CLEAR : IT_0102-KUNNRM.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = IT_0102-KUNNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = IT_0102-KUNNR.

    SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO IT_0102-KUNNRM
                       WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.

**   입/출금/취소구분                                     &nbs
    CASE IT_0102-TRDIV.
      WHEN '10' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '수탁'.  "구외환수탁
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      WHEN '15'.
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '수탁취소'.
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT * -1.
      WHEN '20' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '추심'.  "구하나수탁
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      WHEN '25'.
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '추심취소'. "하나은행 없음
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT * -1.
      WHEN '30' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '반환'.
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT * -1.
      WHEN '40' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '항목변경'. "하나은행 없음
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      WHEN '50' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '부도'.  "하나은행 없음
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT * -1.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '기타'. "하나은행 없음
        IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
    ENDCASE.

    CASE IT_0102-BILL_CLASS.
      WHEN '10'. IT_0102-TRDIVK = '실물어음'.
      WHEN '20'. IT_0102-TRDIVK = '외담대'.
      WHEN '30'. IT_0102-TRDIVK = '전자어음'.
      WHEN '40'. IT_0102-TRDIVK = '구매카드'.
    ENDCASE.

    IF IT_0102-BILL_CLASS = '10'.
      CASE IT_0102-BLTYP.
        WHEN '01'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '환어음'.
        WHEN '02'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '약속어음'.
        WHEN '03'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '당좌수표(국)'.
        WHEN '04'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '당좌수표(영)'.
        WHEN '05'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '가계수표(100만원)'.
        WHEN '06'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '가계수표(500만원)'.
        WHEN '07'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '자기앞수표'.
        WHEN '08'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '우체국'.
        WHEN '99'.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '기타'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          IT_0102-TEXT7 = '어음종류에러'.
      ENDCASE.

      CASE IT_0102-RECGN.  "추심구분
        WHEN '1'.
          IT_0102-TEXT8 = '교환'.
        WHEN '2'.
          IT_0102-TEXT8 = '추심'.
        WHEN '3'.
          IT_0102-TEXT8 = '당점'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          IT_0102-TEXT8 = '추심구분에러'.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      IT_0102-TEXT7 = '실물어음만 해당'.
      IT_0102-TEXT8 = '실물어음만 해당'.
    ENDIF.

    IF NOT IT_0102-BILNU IS INITIAL.
      CASE IT_0102-BANK_CODE.
        WHEN '03' OR '20' OR '81' OR '88'.
          SELECT SINGLE *
            FROM ZFBT102
           WHERE ZBUKR         = P_BUKRS
             AND TRNDT        >= IT_0102-TRNDT
             AND ( ( DOCU_CODE = '0200' AND UPMU_CODE = '300' ) OR
                   ( DOCU_CODE = '0210' AND UPMU_CODE = '640' ) )
             AND BILNU         = IT_0102-BILNU
             AND BANK_CODE     = IT_0102-BANK_CODE.
          IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
            IT_0102-EXP_AMT   = ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.
            IT_0102-RECE_DATE = ZFBT102-TRNDT.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR L_AMT.
    L_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT / 100.
    READ TABLE GT_AR WITH KEY KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR
                              WRBTR = L_AMT.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      IT_0102-ICON = '@5B@'.
      GT_AR-MARK   = '√'.
      GT_AR-P_WRBTR = GT_AR-WRBTR * 100.
      MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX. CLEAR GT_AR.
    ENDIF.

    "참조3넣을 고객명변경
    IF IT_0102-KUNNR IS NOT INITIAL AND IT_0102-KUNNRM IS NOT INITIAL.
      PERFORM KUNNR_NAME_CONV
        USING IT_0102-KUNNRM IT_0102-TEXT11.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY IT_0102 INDEX IDX.     CLEAR IT_0102.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT IT_0102 BY BANK_CODE1
                  TRNDT
                  UBKNT
                  SEND_DATE
                  DOCU_NUMC.

ENDFORM.                    " modify_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DB_CLICK                                &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_P_SELFIELD  text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DB_CLICK  USING    P_SELFIELD TYPE SLIS_SELFIELD.

  CASE P_SELFIELD-SEL_TAB_FIELD.
    WHEN    'IT_0102-BELNR' .
      IF P_SELFIELD-VALUE IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE I000 WITH '값이 존재하는 필드만 더블클릭 하십시요!'.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR RF05L.
        CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
          EXPORTING
            INPUT  = P_SELFIELD-VALUE
          IMPORTING
            OUTPUT = RF05L-BELNR.
        READ TABLE IT_0102 INDEX P_SELFIELD-TABINDEX.
        RF05L-BUKRS = P_BUKRS.
        RF05L-GJAHR = IT_0102-TRNDT(04).

        SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD RF05L-BELNR.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD RF05L-BUKRS.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD RF05L-GJAHR.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN    'IT_0102-BELNR_B' .
      IF P_SELFIELD-VALUE IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE I000 WITH '값이 존재하는 필드만 더블클릭 하십시요!'.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR RF05L.
        CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
          EXPORTING
            INPUT  = P_SELFIELD-VALUE
          IMPORTING
            OUTPUT = RF05L-BELNR.
        READ TABLE IT_0102 INDEX P_SELFIELD-TABINDEX.
        RF05L-BUKRS = P_BUKRS.
        RF05L-GJAHR = IT_0102-BUDAT_B(04).

        SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD RF05L-BELNR.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD RF05L-BUKRS.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD RF05L-GJAHR.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN    'IT_0102-BELNR_A' .
      IF P_SELFIELD-VALUE IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE I000 WITH '값이 존재하는 필드만 더블클릭 하십시요!'.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR RF05L.
        CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
          EXPORTING
            INPUT  = P_SELFIELD-VALUE
          IMPORTING
            OUTPUT = RF05L-BELNR.
        READ TABLE IT_0102 INDEX P_SELFIELD-TABINDEX.
        RF05L-BUKRS = P_BUKRS.
        RF05L-GJAHR = IT_0102-BUDAT_A(04).

        SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD RF05L-BELNR.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD RF05L-BUKRS.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD RF05L-GJAHR.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN OTHERS.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                    " DB_CLICK
*&------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
*&      Form  PF_STATUS_SET                               &n
*&------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
*       외부(REUSE_ALV_EVENTS_GET)에서 CALL한 FORM 문이다.                          
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
FORM  PF_STATUS_SET USING RT_EXTAB TYPE SLIS_T_EXTAB.

  CLEAR RT_EXTAB. REFRESH RT_EXTAB.
  CASE GV_AUTH.
    WHEN 'X'.
      APPEND : 'CUST'    TO RT_EXTAB,
               'DOCU'    TO RT_EXTAB,
               'DOCUCN'  TO RT_EXTAB,
               'DISC'    TO RT_EXTAB,
               'DOCUCN2' TO RT_EXTAB,
               'POST'    TO RT_EXTAB,
               'POSTCN'  TO RT_EXTAB,
               'TEXT'    TO RT_EXTAB.
  ENDCASE.
  SET PF-STATUS 'G0100' EXCLUDING RT_EXTAB.

ENDFORM.                    "PF_STATUS_SET

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  F4_BANK                                &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_P_BANK_LOW  text                              &nbs
*      -->P_0333   text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM F4_ACCT  USING    P_ACCT
                       P_FNAME.
  DATA : SELECTFIELD  LIKE HELP_INFO-FIELDNAME,
         IT_FIELDS    LIKE HELP_VALUE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
         IT_HEAD      TYPE F4TYP_HEADING_TAB   WITH HEADER LINE,
         SELECT_VALUE LIKE HELP_INFO-FLDVALUE,
         IT_T012K     LIKE T012K      OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
         LD_TABIX     LIKE SY-TABIX.

  CLEAR: SELECTFIELD, IT_FIELDS, SELECT_VALUE, LD_TABIX.

  REFRESH: IT_FIELDS.

* F4를 눌렀을때 보여지는 필드 선언.                                  &nbs
  DATA : BEGIN OF IT_VALUE OCCURS 0,
           BANK_CODE1 LIKE ZFBT001-BANK_CODE1,
           BANKN      LIKE T012K-BANKN,
           TEXT       LIKE T012T-TEXT1,
         END OF IT_VALUE.

* 화면 필드 선언 -> 선택된 값을 화면 필드에 뿌려줄때 사용.                           &nbs
  DATA: SCR_FIELDS LIKE DYNPREAD OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.

  CLEAR: IT_VALUE, IT_VALUE[], IT_T012K, IT_T012K[].
  SELECT * FROM T012K
           INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_T012K
          WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
            AND WAERS = 'KRW'.

* 검색된 자료의 존재 여부.                                    &nb
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_T012K.
    IT_VALUE-BANKN = IT_T012K-BANKN.
    SELECT SINGLE TEXT1 FROM T012T INTO IT_VALUE-TEXT
                       WHERE SPRAS = SY-LANGU
                         AND BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                         AND HBKID = IT_T012K-HBKID
                         AND HKTID = IT_T012K-HKTID.
    SELECT SINGLE BANKL FROM T012 INTO IT_VALUE-BANK_CODE1
                       WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                         AND HBKID = IT_T012K-HBKID.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      APPEND IT_VALUE. CLEAR IT_VALUE.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR IT_VALUE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT IT_VALUE BY BANK_CODE1
                   BANKN.

*F4를 눌렀을때 Hit List를 보여준다.                                   
  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'ZFBT001'.
  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'BANK_CODE1'.
  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = ' '. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시
  APPEND IT_FIELDS.
  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012K'.
  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'BANKN'.
  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = 'X'. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시
  APPEND IT_FIELDS.
  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012T'.
  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'TEXT1'.
  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = ' '. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시
  APPEND IT_FIELDS.

  IT_HEAD-TABNAME   = 'ZFBT001'.
  IT_HEAD-FIELDNAME = 'BANK_CODE'.
  IT_HEAD-HEAD_TEXT = '은행코드'.
  APPEND IT_HEAD.

  IT_HEAD-TABNAME   = 'T012K'.
  IT_HEAD-FIELDNAME = 'BANKN'.
  IT_HEAD-HEAD_TEXT = '계좌번호'.
  APPEND IT_HEAD.

  IT_HEAD-TABNAME   = 'T012T'.
  IT_HEAD-FIELDNAME = 'TEXT1'.
  IT_HEAD-HEAD_TEXT = '계좌명'.
  APPEND IT_HEAD.

** F4기능 부분                                       &
  CALL FUNCTION 'HELP_VALUES_GET_NO_DD_NAME'
    EXPORTING
      SELECTFIELD                  = SELECTFIELD
    IMPORTING
      IND                          = LD_TABIX
      SELECT_VALUE                 = SELECT_VALUE
    TABLES
      FIELDS                       = IT_FIELDS
      FULL_TABLE                   = IT_VALUE
      HEADING_TABLE                = IT_HEAD
    EXCEPTIONS
      FULL_TABLE_EMPTY             = 1
      NO_TABLESTRUCTURE_GIVEN      = 2
      NO_TABLEFIELDS_IN_DICTIONARY = 3
      MORE_THEN_ONE_SELECTFIELD    = 4
      NO_SELECTFIELD               = 5
      OTHERS                       = 6.
*                                          &n
*  DOUBLE CLICK시 값을 화면에 DISPLAY                                &n

  CHECK NOT LD_TABIX IS INITIAL.
  READ TABLE IT_VALUE INDEX LD_TABIX.
  P_ACCT = SELECT_VALUE.           "표시될 화면 필드

*DESC을 바로 보여주기 위한 부분.                                   &nbs
*    표시될 화면 필드명 과 값                                &nbs

  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDNAME  = P_FNAME. "반드시 대문자.
  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDVALUE = IT_VALUE-BANKN.
  APPEND SCR_FIELDS.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
    EXPORTING
      DYNAME               = SY-CPROG
      DYNUMB               = SY-DYNNR
    TABLES
      DYNPFIELDS           = SCR_FIELDS
    EXCEPTIONS
      INVALID_ABAPWORKAREA = 1
      INVALID_DYNPROFIELD  = 2
      INVALID_DYNPRONAME   = 3
      INVALID_DYNPRONUMMER = 4
      INVALID_REQUEST      = 5
      NO_FIELDDESCRIPTION  = 6
      UNDEFIND_ERROR       = 7
      OTHERS               = 8.

  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                                                    " F4_ACCT

    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    MOVE IT_0102-BANK_CODE       TO  G_BANK.
    MOVE IT_0102-TEXT            TO  G_BANK_NAME.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRNDT           TO  G_TRNDT.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRNNO           TO  G_TRNNO.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRAN_AMT        TO  G_TRAN_AMT.
    MOVE IT_0102-FNAME           TO  G_FNAME.
    MOVE IT_0102-ZTEXT100        TO  G_TEXT.
    CALL SCREEN '0200'  STARTING AT 015 015.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_TEXT

*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE CHECK_BELNR INPUT.

  IF OK_CODE = 'ENTE'.
    CLEAR : BKPF.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM BKPF
                   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                     AND BELNR = GC_BELNR
                     AND GJAHR = G_GJAHR.
    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
      MESSAGE E000 WITH '전표번호를 확인하십시오.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDMODULE.                 " CHECK_BELNR  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0100  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0100 INPUT.
  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN 'ENTE'.
      IF GC_BELNR IS NOT INITIAL.
        UPDATE ZFBT102  SET BELNR      = GC_BELNR
                             GJAHR      = G_GJAHR
                             BUDAT      = BKPF-BUDAT
                       WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                         AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                         AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                         AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                         AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                         AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                         AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
        IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
        ENDIF.
        LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN 'CANC'.
      MESSAGE S000 WITH '작업을 취소하였습니다!'.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0100  INPUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT .

  DATA : LV_CHK.

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*  CLEAR LV_CHK.                                     &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE  MARK      EQ 'X'.                       &nbs
*    IF IT_0102-BILL_DATE IS INITIAL.                              &nb
*      LV_CHK = 'X'.                                &nb
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.                                   &
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '할인가능일자가 존재하지 않습니다.'.                            &nb
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK     EQ 'X'
                     AND ( TRDIV  EQ '10' OR
                           TRDIV  EQ '20' ).
*                     AND BILL_DATE NE SPACE.               
    IF IT_0102-BELNR NE SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '이미 전표처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
    ELSEIF IT_0102-KUNNR = SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '거래처를 확인하십시오.'.
    ELSE.
*     당일자 만기(현금)는 현금처리                                 
*      IF IT_0102-TRNDT = IT_0102-TRIDT.                            &n
*        PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_BILL.                           &nb
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
      PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION.
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT

  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK   = 'X'                            
*                    AND BELNR <> SPACE.               &nbs
*    PERFORM POSTING_DATA.

          ' ' 'BDC_CURSOR'       'UF05A-STGRD',

          ' ' 'BKPF-BUKRS'       WA_TABLE-ZBUKR,   "회사코드
          ' ' 'RF05A-GJAHS'      WA_TABLE-LAUFD(4)."회계년도

  PERFORM BDC_DYNPRO_FILL USING:
          ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'       '=BU',            "저장
          ' ' 'UF05A-STGRD'      WA_TABLE-STGRD.   "역분개사유코드

*&      Form  CALL_TRANSACTION                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_WA_TABLE  text                               
*      -->P_2646   text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CALL_TRANSACTION TABLES   WA_TABLE STRUCTURE WA_TABLE
                       USING   FP_TCODE.

  CLEAR: GS_CTUPAR, G_BDCRC.

*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_DISPLAY.   "A MODE                          &n
*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_ERRDISP.   "E MODE.                          &
  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_NOTDISP.   "N MODE.
  GS_CTUPAR-UPDMODE  = C_UPDMODE_SYNC.
  GS_CTUPAR-CATTMODE = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-DEFSIZE  = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-RACOMMIT = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBINPT  = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBIEND  = ' '.

  CALL TRANSACTION FP_TCODE
             USING GT_BDCDATA
           OPTIONS FROM GS_CTUPAR
          MESSAGES INTO GT_MESSTAB.

  READ TABLE GT_MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                                 MSGID  = 'F5'
                                 MSGNR  = '312'.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR      = SPACE
                       BUDAT      = SPACE
                       GJAHR      = SPACE
                 WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                   AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                   AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                   AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                   AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                   AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " CALL_TRANSACTION

*  <--  p2        text                            &n

FORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION .

  DATA : L_BANKN LIKE T012K-BANKN,
         L_HKONT LIKE T012K-HKONT,
         L_BANKL LIKE T012-BANKL,
         L_NAME1 LIKE KNA1-NAME1,
         L_MSGV1 LIKE ZFBT102-MSGV1.
  DATA : L_ZUONR  LIKE BSEG-ZUONR.

*  REFRESH : IT_DOCL.                                   &nbs
*  CLEAR   : IT_DOCH,IT_DOCL.                                &nbs
**........................................                                   &nb
*  IT_DOCH-TCODE = 'FB01'.            "TCODE                      
*  IF NOT IT_0102-BILL_DATE IS INITIAL.                               
*    IT_DOCH-BLDAT = IT_0102-BILL_DATE. "증빙일                             &n
*    IT_DOCH-BUDAT = IT_0102-BILL_DATE. "전기일                             &n
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    IT_DOCH-BLDAT = IT_0102-CSGDT.     "증빙일                          
**    IT_DOCH-BUDAT = IT_0102-CSGDT.     "전기일                          
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*  IT_DOCH-BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR.     "회사코드                            
*  IT_DOCH-WAERS = 'KRW'.                                   
*  IT_DOCH-BKTXT = '펌뱅킹 입금전표 처리'.                                
*  IT_DOCH-BLART = 'DZ'.              "전표유형                    &n
**........................................                                   &nb
*  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'D'          ."계정유형                        &nb
*  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '09'         ."전기키                         &nb
** SPECAIL                                        
*  IT_DOCL-NEWUM = 'W'.                                   &n
**  SELECT SINGLE HKONT BANKN FROM T012K                              
**                            INTO (L_HKONT,L_BANKN)         &nbs
**                           WHERE BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR        &
**                             AND HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID      &nb
**                             AND HKTID = IT_0102-HKTID.      &n
*  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = IT_0102-KUNNR.                                 &nbs
** 금액                                         
*  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.                              &
** 지정                                         
*  IF IT_0102-BILNU+18(01) NE SPACE.                                &n
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU+02(18).                              &nb
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                               &nbs
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
**  IF P_BUKRS = '1000'.                                  &n
**    IT_DOCL-GSBER = '2000'.                                &nbs
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    IT_DOCL-GSBER = 'S110'.                                &nbs
**  ENDIF.                                       &
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*  CLEAR : L_BANKL.                                    
*  L_BANKL = IT_0102-BANK_CODE.                                  
*  SELECT SINGLE *  FROM BNKA                                
*                  WHERE BANKS = 'KR'                   
*                    AND BANKL = L_BANKL.                &nb
*  CONCATENATE IT_0102-KUNNR BNKA-BANKA IT_0102-BILNU                             &nb
*         INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.                       &nbs
** 어음정보                                        &nb
*  MOVE IT_0102-TRIDT        TO IT_DOCL-ZFBDT.  "만기일                      &
*  MOVE IT_0102-TRNDT        TO IT_DOCL-WDATE.  "발행일                      &
*  MOVE BNKA-BANKA           TO IT_DOCL-WBANK.  "은행명                   &nbs
*                                          &n
*  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                  
**.........................................                                   &n
*  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'D'          . "계정유형                       &nb
*  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '19'         . "전기키                        &nb
*  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = IT_0102-KUNNR.                                 &nbs
** SPECAIL                                        
*  IT_DOCL-NEWUM = 'A'.                                   &n
*  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.                              &
** 지정                                         
*  IF IT_0102-BILNU+18(01) NE SPACE.                                &n
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU+02(18).                              &nb
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                               &nbs
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
**  IT_DOCL-BUPLA = 'BP10'.                                  &nbs
**  IF P_BUKRS = '1000'.                                  &n
**    IT_DOCL-GSBER = '2000'.                                &nbs
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    IT_DOCL-GSBER = 'S110'.                                &nbs
**  ENDIF.                                       &
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*  IT_DOCL-SGTXT = IT_0102-FNAME.                                 &nbs
*  IF IT_0102-FNAME IS INITIAL.                                 &
*    CLEAR L_NAME1.                                   &
*    SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO L_NAME1                          &n
*                       WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.            &
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      IT_DOCL-SGTXT = L_NAME1.                              &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                  

* 2011.11.16 로직 대체(BY ASANG)                                  &nb
  REFRESH : IT_DOCL.
  CLEAR   : IT_DOCH,IT_DOCL.

  IT_DOCH-TCODE = 'FB01'.            "TCODE
  IF NOT IT_0102-TRNDT IS INITIAL.
    G_BUDAT = IT_0102-TRNDT. "증빙일
  ENDIF.

  IT_DOCH-BLDAT = G_BUDAT.
  IT_DOCH-BUDAT = G_BUDAT.
  IT_DOCH-BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR.     "회사코드
  IT_DOCH-WAERS = 'KRW'.
  IT_DOCH-BKTXT = '펌뱅킹 입금전표 처리'.
  IT_DOCH-BLART = 'BA'.              "전표유형
*........................................                                   &nbs
  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'D'          ."계정유형
  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '11'. "'09'         ."전기키
  IT_DOCL-HKONT = '11105010'.    "외상매출금
* SPECAIL                                        &
*  IT_DOCL-NEWUM = 'B'.  "20200211                                

  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = IT_0102-KUNNR.
* 금액                                         
  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
* 지정                                         
  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.
**  IT_DOCL-GSBER = '10001'.                                  &nb
* 아이템TEXT                                        &
  CLEAR L_NAME1.
  SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO L_NAME1
                     WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.
  CONCATENATE '받을어음' L_NAME1
         INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
* 어음정보                                        &nbs
  L_BANKL = IT_0102-BANK_CODE1.
  SELECT SINGLE *  FROM BNKA
                  WHERE BANKS = 'KR'
                    AND BANKL = L_BANKL.
  MOVE IT_0102-TRIDT        TO IT_DOCL-ZFBDT.  "만기일
*  MOVE BNKA-BANKA           TO IT_DOCL-WBANK.  "은행명                   &nbs

  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.
*.........................................                                   &nb
*  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'D'          . "계정유형                       &nb
*  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '19'         . "전기키                        &nb
*  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = IT_0102-KUNNR.                                 &nbs
*  IT_DOCL-NEWUM = 'B'.           "SGL                       &nbs

  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'D'          . "계정유형
  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '01'. "'15'  . "전기키
  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = IT_0102-KUNNR.
  IT_DOCL-HKONT = '11105012'.    "받을어음

  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
* 지정                                         
*  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                                 &nbs
  CONCATENATE IT_0102-BILNU(15) '002'
         INTO IT_DOCL-ZUONR.
* 아이템TEXT                                        &
  CLEAR L_NAME1.
  SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO L_NAME1
                     WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.
  CONCATENATE '받을어음' L_NAME1
         INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.

*.....................................                                    &
* 전표생성                                        &nbs
  GV_MODE = 'E'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'ZFB_PROCESS_00002100 '
    EXPORTING
      DOCH    = IT_DOCH
      MODE    = GV_MODE
    IMPORTING
      MESSAGE = G_MESSAGE_S
    TABLES
      DOCL    = IT_DOCL.

  IF G_MESSAGE_S-MSGTY = 'S' AND G_MESSAGE_S-MSGNO = '312'.
    G_BELNR = G_MESSAGE_S-MSGV1.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = G_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.
    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR      = G_BELNR
                       BUDAT      = IT_DOCH-BUDAT
                       GJAHR      = IT_DOCH-BUDAT(04)
                 WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                   AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                   AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                   AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                   AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                   AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET MSGV1      = W_MSG
                 WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                   AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                   AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                   AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                   AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                   AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_POST                             &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_POST .

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE S006. EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : G_BUDAT, OK_CODE.
  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_0102 TO GS_0102.
  G_BUDAT = IT_0102-TRIDT.
  CALL SCREEN '0500'  STARTING AT 015 015.
  CHECK OK_CODE = '0500_OK'.
  IF G_BUDAT IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE S000 WITH '만기일자를 입력해야 합니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK   = 'X'.
    CLEAR : G_INPUT_AMT, G_FEE_AMT.
    IF IT_0102-BELNR_B NE SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '이미 전표처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
      EXIT.
    ELSEIF IT_0102-BELNR = SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '입금전표 처리후 작업이 가능합니다.'.
      EXIT.
    ELSEIF IT_0102-ENTE_CODE NE 'UPLOAD'.
      CLEAR ZFBT102.
      SELECT SINGLE *
               FROM ZFBT102
              WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO
                AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        IF IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT NE IT_0102-EXP_AMT.
          MESSAGE S000 WITH '만기입금내역이 없습니다.'.
*          EXIT.                               &nb
          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.
          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
        ELSE.
          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.
          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        IF IT_0102-TRAN_AMT NE IT_0102-EXP_AMT.
          MESSAGE S000 WITH '만기입금내역이 없습니다.'.
*          EXIT.                               &nb
          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
        ELSE.
          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR ZFBT102.
      SELECT SINGLE *
               FROM ZFBT102
              WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO
                AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.
      ELSE.
        G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      ENDIF.
      PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_POST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_POST_CANCEL                             
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_POST_CANCEL .

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK    = 'X'
                               BELNR_B = SPACE.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE S000 WITH '만기전표번호가 생성되지 않은 데이터 입니다.'
                      '데이터를 확인하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK    EQ 'X'
                     AND BELNR_B NE SPACE.
    PERFORM DOCUMENT_POST_FBRA_CANCEL.
  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK    EQ 'X'
                     AND BELNR_B NE SPACE.
    PERFORM DOCUMENT_POST_CANCEL.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_POST_CANCEL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER                              &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER .

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    IF IT_0102-BELNR NE SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '이미 전표처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
    ELSE..
      MOVE IT_0102-BANK_CODE       TO  G_BANK.
      MOVE IT_0102-TEXT            TO  G_BANK_NAME.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRNDT           TO  G_TRNDT.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRNNO           TO  G_TRNNO.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRAN_AMT        TO  G_TRAN_AMT.
      MOVE IT_0102-FNAME           TO  G_FNAME.
      MOVE IT_0102-KUNNR           TO  G_KUNNR.
      MOVE IT_0102-KUNNRM          TO  G_NAME.
      CALL SCREEN '0300'  STARTING AT  30  012.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  STATUS_0300  OUTPUT                            &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE STATUS_0300 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS '0300'.
  SET TITLEBAR  '0300'.
ENDMODULE.                 " STATUS_0300  OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  CHECK_FIELD  INPUT                            &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE CHECK_FIELD INPUT.

  IF OK_CODE NE '0300_CN'.
    IF NOT G_KUNNR IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
        EXPORTING
          INPUT  = G_KUNNR
        IMPORTING
          OUTPUT = G_KUNNR.

      SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO G_NAME
                         WHERE KUNNR = G_KUNNR.
      IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
        MESSAGE E000 WITH '거래처코드를 확인하십시오.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR G_NAME.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDMODULE.                 " CHECK_FIELD  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0300  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0300 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0300_OK'.
      UPDATE ZFBT102 SET KUNNR     = G_KUNNR
                   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        MESSAGE S100. COMMIT WORK.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

    WHEN '0300_CN'.
      CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0300  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST                             
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST .

  DATA : L_BANKN     LIKE T012K-BANKN,
         L_HKONT     LIKE T012K-HKONT,
         L_BANKL     LIKE T012-BANKL,
         L_MSGV1     LIKE ZFBT102-MSGV1,
         L_NAME1     LIKE KNA1-NAME1,
         LV_CHAR(30).

  DATA : L_ZUONR  LIKE BSEG-ZUONR.

  DATA : BEGIN OF LT_0102 OCCURS 0,
           BELNR_B LIKE ZFBT102-BELNR_B,
         END OF LT_0102.

  CLEAR : G_DISC_AMT, GS_0102.
  CLEAR LT_0102. REFRESH LT_0102.
  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_0102
    FROM ZFBT102
   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
     AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO.
*     AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.                               &nb

  REFRESH : IT_DOCL.
  CLEAR   : IT_DOCH,IT_DOCL.
*........................................                                   &nbs
  IF IT_0102-ENTE_CODE = 'UPLOAD' OR IT_0102-EXP_AMT = 0.
    IT_0102-RECE_DATE = G_BUDAT.
  ELSE.
  ENDIF.
  IT_DOCH-TCODE = 'FB05'.            "TCODE
  IT_DOCH-BLDAT = G_BUDAT.           "증빙일
  IT_DOCH-BLART = 'T6'.              "전표유형
  IT_DOCH-BUDAT = G_BUDAT.           "전기일(현금입금일)
  IT_DOCH-BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR.     "회사코드
  IT_DOCH-WAERS = C_WAERS_KRW.
  IT_DOCH-BKTXT = '[펌뱅킹] 받을어음만기'.
  IT_DOCH-AUGLV = 'EINGZAHL'.
*                  AUSGZAHL = 지급                    &nb
*                  EINGZAHL = 입금                    &nb
*                  GUTSCHRI = 대변 메모                   &
*                  UMBUCHNG = 반제하여 대체전기                  &nb
*........................................                                   &nbs
*  IF IT_0102-BELNR_A IS INITIAL.                                 
  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형
  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키

  CASE IT_0102-BILL_CLASS.
    WHEN '10'. LV_CHAR = `IPGU_ACCT1 = 'X'`.
    WHEN '20'. LV_CHAR = `IPGU_ACCT2 = 'X'`.
    WHEN '30'. LV_CHAR = `IPGU_ACCT3 = 'X'`.
  ENDCASE.
  CLEAR ZFBT020.
  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM ZFBT020
   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
     AND BANK_CODE1 = IT_0102-BANK_CODE1
     AND (LV_CHAR).

  SELECT SINGLE HKONT BANKN
           INTO (L_HKONT,L_BANKN)
           FROM T012K
          WHERE BUKRS = ZFBT020-ZBUKR
            AND HBKID = ZFBT020-HBKID
            AND HKTID = ZFBT020-HKTID.

  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = L_HKONT.
  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT - G_FEE_AMT.
  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.
  IT_DOCL-HBKID = ZFBT020-HBKID.
  IT_DOCL-HKTID = ZFBT020-HKTID.
  CONCATENATE '어음만기' IT_0102-KUNNRM
        INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.
  IF G_FEE_AMT IS NOT INITIAL.
    IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형
    IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키
    IT_DOCL-NEWKO = C_HKONT_FEE2.
    IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = G_FEE_AMT.
    IT_DOCL-KOSTL = GV_KOSTL.
    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.
    SELECT SINGLE NAME1
              INTO L_NAME1
              FROM KNA1
             WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.
    CONCATENATE '전자어음수수료' L_NAME1
          INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
    APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.
  ENDIF.

*.........................................                                   &nb
*구매카드                                         &nbs
  DATA : LV_SELBIS LIKE IT_CLEAR-SELBIS.
  CONCATENATE IT_0102-BELNR IT_0102-TRNDT(04) '001'
         INTO LV_SELBIS.
  CLEAR IT_CLEAR. REFRESH IT_CLEAR.
  IT_CLEAR-AGKOA  = 'D'    .       "계정유형
  IT_CLEAR-AGKON  = IT_0102-KUNNR. "계정번호 또는 작업리스트키
  IT_CLEAR-AGBUK  = IT_0102-ZBUKR. "회사코드
  IT_CLEAR-XNOPS  = 'X'     .
  "지시자: 특별 G/L이 아닌 미결항목만 선택합니까?
  IT_CLEAR-XFIFO  = ''."지시자: 만기일에 따라 자동으로 배부
  IT_CLEAR-AGUMS  = 'W'     ."선택할 특별 G/L지시자
  IT_CLEAR-AVSID  = ''     ."지급통지서번호
  IT_CLEAR-SELFD  = 'BELNR'."전표인덱스의 필드이름
  IT_CLEAR-SELVON = LV_SELBIS. "IT_0102-BELNR.
  "미결항목선택에 대한 탐색기준의 입력필드 시작
  IT_CLEAR-SELBIS = '' ."미결항목선택에 대한 탐색기준
  APPEND IT_CLEAR.CLEAR IT_CLEAR.

*  LOOP AT LT_0102.                                    
*    IT_CLEAR-AGKOA  = 'D'    .       "                     
*    IT_CLEAR-AGKON  = IT_0102-KUNNR. "                             &n
*    IT_CLEAR-AGBUK  = IT_0102-ZBUKR. "                             &n
*    IT_CLEAR-XNOPS  = 'X'     .                           &
*    IT_CLEAR-XFIFO  = ''     ."                           &
*    IT_CLEAR-AGUMS  = ''     ."                           &
*    IT_CLEAR-AVSID  = ''     ."                           &
*    IT_CLEAR-SELFD  = 'BELNR'."                               &n
*    IT_CLEAR-SELVON = LT_0102-BELNR_B.                               
*    IT_CLEAR-SELBIS = ''     ."                            
*    APPEND IT_CLEAR.CLEAR IT_CLEAR.                               &nb
*  ENDLOOP.                                       

*.....................................                                    &
* 전표생성                                        &nbs
  GV_MODE = 'E'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'ZFB_PROCESS_00002100 '
    EXPORTING
      DOCH    = IT_DOCH
      MODE    = GV_MODE
    IMPORTING
      MESSAGE = G_MESSAGE_S
    TABLES
      DOCL    = IT_DOCL
      CLEAR   = IT_CLEAR.

  IF G_MESSAGE_S-MSGTY = 'S' AND G_MESSAGE_S-MSGNO = '312'.
    G_BELNR = G_MESSAGE_S-MSGV1.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = G_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.
    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET  BELNR_B    = G_BELNR
                         BUDAT_B    = G_BUDAT  "IT_0102-TRIDT
                         FEE_AMT    = G_FEE_AMT
                   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET MSGV1      = W_MSG
                   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST

*       text                                  &nbs

*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DOCUMENT_POST_CANCEL .

* 지급전표의 역분개 처리.                                     &nb
  MOVE P_BUKRS         TO WA_TABLE-ZBUKR.
  MOVE IT_0102-BELNR_B TO WA_TABLE-BELNR.
  CLEAR: GT_BDCDATA, GT_BDCDATA[], GT_MESSTAB, GT_MESSTAB[].
  WA_TABLE-LAUFD = IT_0102-BUDAT_B.
  WA_TABLE-GJAHR = IT_0102-BUDAT_B.
  WA_TABLE-STGRD = C_STGRD1.
  PERFORM SAPMF05A_0105 TABLES WA_TABLE.
  PERFORM CALL_TRANSACTION1 TABLES WA_TABLE
                            USING 'FB08'.

ENDFORM.                    " DOCUMENT_POST_CANCEL

*       text                                  &nbs

*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DOCUMENT_PART_CANCEL USING PS_0102 LIKE ZFBT102.

* 지급전표의 역분개 처리.                                     &nb
  MOVE P_BUKRS         TO WA_TABLE-ZBUKR.
  MOVE PS_0102-BELNR_B TO WA_TABLE-BELNR.
  CLEAR: GT_BDCDATA, GT_BDCDATA[], GT_MESSTAB, GT_MESSTAB[].
  WA_TABLE-LAUFD = PS_0102-BUDAT_B.
  WA_TABLE-GJAHR = PS_0102-BUDAT_B.
  WA_TABLE-STGRD = '02'.
  PERFORM SAPMF05A_0105 TABLES WA_TABLE.

  CLEAR: GS_CTUPAR, G_BDCRC.

*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_DISPLAY.   "A MODE                          &n
*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_ERRDISP.   "E MODE.                          &
  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_NOTDISP.   "N MODE.
  GS_CTUPAR-UPDMODE  = C_UPDMODE_SYNC.
  GS_CTUPAR-CATTMODE = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-DEFSIZE  = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-RACOMMIT = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBINPT  = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBIEND  = ' '.

  CALL TRANSACTION 'FB08'
             USING GT_BDCDATA
           OPTIONS FROM GS_CTUPAR
          MESSAGES INTO GT_MESSTAB.

  READ TABLE GT_MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                                 MSGID  = 'F5'
                                 MSGNR  = '312'.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
*    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET BELNR_B    = SPACE                        &nb
*                         BUDAT_B    = SPACE          &
*                   WHERE ZBUKR      = PS_0102-ZBUKR           &n
*                     AND BANK_CODE  = PS_0102-BANK_CODE            &n
*                     AND ENTE_CODE  = PS_0102-ENTE_CODE            &n
*                     AND SEND_DATE  = PS_0102-SEND_DATE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_CODE  = PS_0102-DOCU_CODE            &n
*                     AND UPMU_CODE  = PS_0102-UPMU_CODE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = PS_0102-DOCU_NUMC.            &
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.                    " DOCUMENT_POST_CANCEL

*  <--  p2        text                            &n

FORM DOCUMENT_POST_FBRA_CANCEL .

  CLEAR: GT_BDCDATA, GT_BDCDATA[], GT_MESSTAB, GT_MESSTAB[].
  PERFORM BDC_DYNPRO_FILL USING:
          'X' 'SAPMF05R'        '0100',
          ' ' 'BDC_CURSOR'      'RF05R-AUGBL',
          ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'      '=RAGL',
          ' ' 'RF05R-AUGBL'      IT_0102-BELNR_B,    "지급전표번호
          ' ' 'RF05R-BUKRS'      P_BUKRS,            "회사코드
          ' ' 'RF05R-GJAHR'      IT_0102-BUDAT_B(04)."회계년도

  CLEAR: GS_CTUPAR, G_BDCRC.

*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_DISPLAY.   "A MODE                          &n
*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_ERRDISP.   "E MODE.                          &
  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_NOTDISP.   "N MODE.
  GS_CTUPAR-UPDMODE  = C_UPDMODE_SYNC.
  GS_CTUPAR-CATTMODE = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-DEFSIZE  = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-RACOMMIT = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBINPT  = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBIEND  = ' '.

  CALL TRANSACTION 'FBRA'
             USING GT_BDCDATA
           OPTIONS FROM GS_CTUPAR
          MESSAGES INTO GT_MESSTAB.

  READ TABLE GT_MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'.

          ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'      '=RAGL',               "
          ' ' 'RF05R-AUGBL'      PS_0102-BELNR_B,      "지급전표번호
          ' ' 'RF05R-BUKRS'      P_BUKRS,              "회사코드
          ' ' 'RF05R-GJAHR'      PS_0102-BUDAT_B(04).  "회계년도

  CLEAR: GS_CTUPAR, G_BDCRC.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CALL_TRANSACTION1                              &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_WA_TABLE  text                               
*      -->P_3794   text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CALL_TRANSACTION1 TABLES   WA_TABLE STRUCTURE WA_TABLE
                        USING   FP_TCODE.

  CLEAR: GS_CTUPAR, G_BDCRC.

*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_DISPLAY.   "A MODE                          &n
*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_ERRDISP.   "E MODE.                          &
  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_NOTDISP.   "N MODE.
  GS_CTUPAR-UPDMODE  = C_UPDMODE_SYNC.
  GS_CTUPAR-CATTMODE = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-DEFSIZE  = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-RACOMMIT = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBINPT  = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBIEND  = ' '.

  CALL TRANSACTION FP_TCODE
             USING GT_BDCDATA
           OPTIONS FROM GS_CTUPAR
          MESSAGES INTO GT_MESSTAB.

  READ TABLE GT_MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                                 MSGID  = 'F5'
                                 MSGNR  = '312'.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    IF IT_0102-PART_GUBN = 'X'.
      DELETE FROM ZFBT102
            WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
              AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
              AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
              AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
              AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
              AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
              AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        MESSAGE S000
           WITH '역분개 처리 후'
                '분할된 거래내역을 삭제하였습니다.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      UPDATE ZFBT102  SET BELNR_B    = SPACE
                           BUDAT_B    = SPACE
                           FEE_AMT    = SPACE
                     WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                       AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                       AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                       AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                       AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                       AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                       AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " CALL_TRANSACTION1
