*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE STATUS_0600 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS '0600'.
  SET TITLEBAR  '0600'.
ENDMODULE.                 " STATUS_0600  OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  EXIT  INPUT                             &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE EXIT INPUT.
  CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
ENDMODULE.                 " EXIT  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0600  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0600 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0600_OK'.
      PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
        USING '[어음 분할할인 확인]'
              '입력한 정보로 분할할인 처리 하시겠습니까?'
              SPACE SPACE
     CHANGING G_ANSWER.
      CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.
      PERFORM DOCUMENT_POST.
  ENDCASE.

  CLEAR OK_CODE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0600  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_PART                             &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_PART .

*  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C,                                 
*         LV_CNT     TYPE I.                         &n
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_UBKNT_CHAR(18) TYPE C.                               &nbs
*  CLEAR : GS_PART, OK_CODE.                                 &nbs
*                                          &n
*  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.                            
*  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.                                  
*    MESSAGE S000                                   &nb
*       WITH '분할 대상을 선택하여 주십시요.'.                            
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ELSEIF IT_0102-BILL_DATE = IT_0102-TRIDT.                               
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '당일자 현금은 분할처리를 할 수없습니다.'.                          &
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR LV_CHK.                                     &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK     = 'X'                          
*                    AND BELNR    = SPACE.              
*    LV_CHK = 'X'.                                  &nb
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.                                   &
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '어음 입금전표가 생성되지 않은 건 입니다.'                         &n
*            '분할 할 수 없습니다.'.                         &n
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR LV_CHK.                                     &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK     = 'X'                          
*                    AND BELNR_B <> SPACE.               &n
*    LV_CHK = 'X'.                                  &nb
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.                                   &
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '이미 만기반제 처리 된 건은'                           &nb
*            '분할 할 수 없습니다.'.                         &n
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR LV_CNT.                                     &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK  = 'X'.                             
*    LV_CNT = LV_CNT + 1.                               &nbs
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*  IF LV_CNT > 1.                                   
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '한 건씩 진행하여 주십시요.'.                            &
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.                            
*  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                   &
*    MOVE : IT_0102-BANK_CODE1 TO GS_PART-BANK_CODE1,                           
*           IT_0102-TRNDT      TO GS_PART-TRNDT,                   &nb
*           IT_0102-BILNU      TO GS_PART-BILNU,                   &nb
*           IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   TO GS_PART-TRAN_AMT,                     &nb
*           IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT TO GS_PART-BLNC_AMT,                       &
*           IT_0102-GJAHR      TO GS_PART-GJAHR,                   &nb
*           IT_0102-BELNR      TO GS_PART-BELNR,                   &nb
*           IT_0102-BUDAT      TO GS_PART-BUDAT,                   &nb
*           IT_0102-KUNNR      TO GS_PART-KUNNR.                   &nb
*                                          &n
*    CLEAR GS_PART-TEXT.                                  &n
*    SELECT SINGLE TEXT                                 &nbs
*             INTO GS_PART-TEXT                         &nbs
*             FROM ZFBT056                          &nb
*            WHERE BANK_CODE1 = GS_PART-BANK_CODE1.                     &nb
*                                          &n
*    CLEAR ZFBT050.                                   &
*    SELECT SINGLE *                                  &
*             FROM ZFBT050                          &nb
*            WHERE BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE.                      
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      MOVE ZFBT050-HKONT TO GS_PART-HKONT.                            
*                                          &n
*      CLEAR GS_PART-BANKN.                                &
*      SELECT SINGLE BANKN                               &nb
*               INTO GS_PART-BANKN                       &nb
*               FROM T012K                         
*              WHERE BUKRS    = P_BUKRS                   &n
*                AND HKONT    = ZFBT050-HKONT.                &nb
**      PERFORM INC_DECRYPT_VALUE USING 'D' 'N'                          &n
**                                      GS_PART-BANKN  
**                             CHANGING LV_UBKNT_CHAR.        &nb
*      MOVE GS_PART-BANKN    TO LV_UBKNT_CHAR.                         
*      DO.                                    
*        REPLACE '-' WITH ' '   INTO LV_UBKNT_CHAR.                    &nbs
*        IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.                            
*          EXIT.                               &nb
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDDO.                                   &n
*      CONDENSE LV_UBKNT_CHAR NO-GAPS.                             &nb
*      CLEAR GS_PART-BANKN.                                &
**      PERFORM INC_DECRYPT_VALUE USING 'I' 'N'                          &n
**                                      LV_UBKNT_CHAR  
**                             CHANGING GS_PART-BANKN.        &nb
*      MOVE LV_UBKNT_CHAR          TO GS_PART-BANKN.                   
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO GS_PART-NAME1                         &n
*                       WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.            &
*                                          &n
*    IF NOT GS_PART IS INITIAL.                              &nbs
*      CALL SCREEN 0600 STARTING AT 20 5.                         &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_PART
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DOCUMENT_POST                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DOCUMENT_POST .

  DATA : LV_CNT     TYPE I.

  DATA : LV_BELNR LIKE BKPF-BELNR,
         LV_GJAHR LIKE BKPF-GJAHR,
         LV_BUDAT LIKE BKPF-BUDAT.

  DATA : LV_MESSAGE(100) TYPE C.

  DATA : L_TEXT(30) TYPE C,
         L_TEXT1    LIKE BSEG-SGTXT.
  DATA : NUM16(16) TYPE N,
         NUM14(14) TYPE N.

  DATA : L_TOT_AMT       LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.
  DATA : L_TRAN_AMT     TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_GAP_AMT      TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_FEE_AMT      TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_PART_AMT(15) TYPE C.

  DATA : SEL01           LIKE RF05A-SEL01.

  CLEAR : L_TRAN_AMT, L_GAP_AMT, LV_BELNR,
          LV_GJAHR,   LV_BUDAT,  BDC_TAB,
          MESSTAB,    L_TEXT1.

  REFRESH : BDC_TAB, MESSTAB.

*  L_TRAN_AMT = NUM16 = GS_PART-PART_AMT.                              &nbs
  L_TRAN_AMT = NUM16 = GS_PART-CURR_AMT.
  L_FEE_AMT  = NUM16 = GS_PART-FEE_AMT.
  L_TOT_AMT  = GS_PART-PART_AMT. " + GS_PART-FEE_AMT.
  L_PART_AMT = L_TOT_AMT.
*  L_PART_AMT = NUM16 = L_TOT_AMT.                                
*  L_GAP_AMT  = GS_PART-GAP_AMT.                                 
  L_TEXT     = '펌뱅킹 어음할인(분할)'.
  CONCATENATE L_TEXT  GS_PART-NAME1
         INTO L_TEXT1 SEPARATED BY SPACE.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
   'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0122'                ,  " Posting and Clearing
   ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'                 ,  " ENTER(OK-CODE)
   ' '  'BKPF-BLDAT'   GS_PART-TRIDT               ,  " Document Date
   ' '  'BKPF-BLART'   'DZ'                  ,  " Document Type
   ' '  'BKPF-BUKRS'   P_BUKRS              ,  " Company Code
   ' '  'BKPF-BUDAT'   GS_PART-TRIDT         ,  " Posting Date
   ' '  'BKPF-MONAT'   GS_PART-TRIDT+4(02)     ,  " Period
   ' '  'BKPF-WAERS'   'KRW'              ,  " Currency
   ' '  'BKPF-BKTXT'   L_TEXT,
   ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40'             ,  " Posting key (차변)1
   ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  GS_PART-HKONT    .  " Account     (차변)1
*   ' '  'RF05A-NEWUM'  'W'              .  " Special G/L (차변)1         &nb

* 외화 수수료가 발생했을 경우 수수료 입력                                 &nb
  IF NOT GS_PART-FEE_AMT IS INITIAL.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  " G/L account line item
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'          ,  " (OK-CODE)
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  " Amount
     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   GS_PART-BILNU(18)  ,  " 지정=어음번호
     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   L_TEXT1 ," 텍스트=구분텍스트+구매처명
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40' ,           " Posting key (차변)1
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  '861-06-001'  .  " Account     (차변)1

*    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                &
*         'X'  'SAPLKACB'           '0002'         ,  "      
*         ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'         '=ENTE'        .  "       &nb

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  " G/L account line item
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=SL'          ,  " (OK-CODE)
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_FEE_AMT      ,  " Amount
     ' '  'COBL-KOSTL'   'JAA'          ,
     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   GS_PART-BILNU(18)  ,  " 지정=어음번호
     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   L_TEXT1        .
  ELSE.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  " G/L account line item
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=SL'          ,  " (OK-CODE)
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  " Amount
     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   GS_PART-BILNU  ,  " 지정=어음번호
     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   L_TEXT1  .
  ENDIF.

*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'  'SAPLKACB'           '0002'         ,  "        
*       ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'         '=ENTE'        ,  "         &nb
*       ' '  'BSEG-KOSTL'         'JAA'          .          

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0710'       , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGBUK'      '1000'        , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGKOA'      'D'          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGUMS'      'W'          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XNOPS'      ' '          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(01)'  ' '          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(03)'  'X'          , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'        . "

*  CONCATENATE GS_PART-BELNR GS_PART-GJAHR GS_PART-BUZEI INTO SEL01.                         &n
  PERFORM SCREEN_I USING GS_PART-BELNR.                     "SEL01.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0731'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PA'        . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PART'      . "
*       ' '   'RF05A-ABPOS'      '1'.                      &

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=OSU'       .

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '2000'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'        , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(03)'      'X'.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '0731'        , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'         , "
       ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  GS_PART-BELNR.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X' 'SAPDF05X'           '3100'          , "
       ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'         'OMX'           . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X' 'SAPDF05X'           '3100'          , "
       ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'         'Z+'           . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'         , "
       ' '   'DF05B-PSZAH(01)'  L_PART_AMT    .

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , " "분할금액입력,저장
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=BU'         . "

  PERFORM CALL_TRANS USING 'FB05' 'E'.

  READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                              MSGNR  = '312'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    LV_BELNR = MESSTAB-MSGV1.

    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = LV_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = LV_BELNR.

    CLEAR BKPF.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM BKPF
                   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                     AND BELNR = LV_BELNR
                     AND GJAHR = GS_PART-TRIDT(04).
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      LV_GJAHR = BKPF-GJAHR.
      LV_BUDAT = BKPF-BUDAT.
      PERFORM INSERT_ZFBT102 USING LV_BELNR LV_GJAHR LV_BUDAT.
    ELSE.
      CONCATENATE '전표번호:'
                  LV_BELNR
                  ':전표생성 확인 중 오류가 발생하였습니다.'
             INTO LV_MESSAGE.
      CLEAR LV_BELNR.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'E'.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'
        EXPORTING
          MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID
          MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR
          MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1
          MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2
          MSGV3               = MESSTAB-MSGV3
          MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4
        IMPORTING
          MESSAGE_TEXT_OUTPUT = LV_MESSAGE.
    ELSE.
      READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'
          EXPORTING
            MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID
            MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR
            MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1
            MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2
            MSGV3               = MESSTAB-MSGV3
            MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4
          IMPORTING
            MESSAGE_TEXT_OUTPUT = LV_MESSAGE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " DOCUMENT_POST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DYNPRO                                &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_5070   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_5071   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_5072   text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DYNPRO USING   DYNBEGIN NAME VALUE.

  CLEAR BDC_TAB.
  IF DYNBEGIN = 'X'.
    MOVE : NAME  TO BDC_TAB-PROGRAM,
           VALUE TO BDC_TAB-DYNPRO,
           'X'   TO BDC_TAB-DYNBEGIN.
  ELSE.
    MOVE   NAME  TO BDC_TAB-FNAM.
    MOVE   VALUE TO BDC_TAB-FVAL.
  ENDIF.
  APPEND BDC_TAB.
  CLEAR  BDC_TAB.

ENDFORM.                    " DYNPRO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SCREEN_I                                &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_PT_AR_BELNR  text                              &nb
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SCREEN_I USING DOCNO.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0731'       , "
*     ' '   'RF05A-FELDN(01)'  'BELNR',                           
     ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  DOCNO, "
*     ' '   'RF05A-SEL02(01)'  DOCNO, "                          
     ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'        . "

ENDFORM.                    " SCREEN_I
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

*&      Form  INSERT_ZFBT102                               &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_LV_BELNR  text                               
*      -->P_LV_GJAHR  text                               
*      -->P_LV_BUDAT  text                               
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM INSERT_ZFBT102  USING    P_BELNR
                               P_GJAHR
                               P_BUDAT.

  DATA : LS_0102 LIKE ZFBT102.
  DATA : LV_ENTE_CODE LIKE ZFBT102-ENTE_CODE.

  CLEAR LS_0102.
  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_0102 TO LS_0102.
    MOVE : GS_PART-PART_AMT    TO LS_0102-TRAN_AMT,
           GS_PART-FEE_AMT     TO LS_0102-FEE_AMT,
           P_BELNR             TO LS_0102-BELNR_B,
           P_BUDAT             TO LS_0102-BUDAT_B.

    LS_0102-TRAN_AMT = LS_0102-TRAN_AMT." + LS_0102-FEE_AMT.

    CLEAR LV_ENTE_CODE.
    SELECT MAX( ENTE_CODE )
      INTO LV_ENTE_CODE
      FROM ZFBT102
     WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
       AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
       AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
       AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
       AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
       AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
       AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
       AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO
       AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.

    IF LV_ENTE_CODE(06) = '999999'.
      LV_ENTE_CODE = LV_ENTE_CODE + 1.
    ELSE.
      LV_ENTE_CODE = '999999000001'.
    ENDIF.

    MOVE : LV_ENTE_CODE TO LS_0102-ENTE_CODE,
           'X'          TO LS_0102-PART_GUBN.

    INSERT ZFBT102 FROM LS_0102.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
    ELSE.
      PERFORM DOCUMENT_FBRA_CANCEL USING LS_0102.
      PERFORM DOCUMENT_PART_CANCEL USING LS_0102.

      MESSAGE I000
         WITH '거래내역 생성 중 오류가 발생하였습니다.'
              '확인 후 다시 생성하여 주십시요.'.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " INSERT_ZFBT102

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE CHECK_AMT INPUT.

  DATA : LV_TOT_AMT LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.

  CLEAR LV_TOT_AMT.
*  LV_TOT_AMT = GS_PART-PART_AMT + GS_PART-FEE_AMT.                             
  LV_TOT_AMT       = GS_PART-PART_AMT - GS_PART-FEE_AMT.
  GS_PART-CURR_AMT = GS_PART-PART_AMT - GS_PART-FEE_AMT.

  IF LV_TOT_AMT > GS_PART-BLNC_AMT.
    SET CURSOR FIELD 'GS_PART-PART_AMT'
               LINE  0.
    MESSAGE E000
       WITH '입력한 금액이 분할 후 잔액보다 큽니다.'.
  ELSEIF GS_PART-PART_AMT = 0.
    CLEAR OK_CODE.
  ELSEIF GS_PART-FEE_AMT = 0.
    CLEAR OK_CODE.
  ENDIF.

ENDMODULE.                 " CHECK_AMT  INPUT

    EXPORTING

FORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_BILL .

*  DATA : L_BANKN LIKE T012K-BANKN,                               &nbs
*         L_HKONT LIKE T012K-HKONT,                           &nb
*         L_BANKL LIKE T012-BANKL,                           &nbs
*         L_MSGV1 LIKE ZFBT102-MSGV1.                           &
*  DATA : L_NAME1      LIKE KNA1-NAME1.                           
*                                          &n
*  REFRESH : IT_DOCL.                                   &nbs
*  CLEAR   : IT_DOCH,IT_DOCL, G_MESSAGE_S.                             &nbs
*                                          &n
**.........................................                                   &n
*  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          .        "계정유형                &nb
*  IT_DOCH-TCODE = 'FB01'.               "TCODE                   
*  IT_DOCH-BLDAT = IT_0102-TRNDT.        "증빙일

*  IT_DOCH-BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR.        "회사코드                         
*  IT_DOCH-WAERS = 'KRW'.                                   
*  IT_DOCH-BKTXT = '펌뱅킹 입금전표 처리'.                                
*  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '19'         . "전기키                        &nb
*  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = IT_0102-KUNNR.                                 &nbs
*  IT_DOCL-NEWUM = 'A'.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.                              &
** 지정                                         
*  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                                 &nbs
**  IF P_BUKRS = '1000'.                                  &n
***  IT_DOCL-GSBER = '10001'.                                  &n
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    IT_DOCL-GSBER = 'S110'.                                &nbs
**  ENDIF.                                       &
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*  SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO L_NAME1                            &n
*                     WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.              &
*                                          &n

**                                          &
**  IT_DOCL-SGTXT = IT_0102-FNAME.                                 &nb
*  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                  
**........................................                                   &nb

*  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키                         &nb
*  SELECT SINGLE HKONT FROM ZFBT050                               &nbs
*                      INTO L_HKONT                 &nb
*                     WHERE BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE.             
** 계정                                         
*  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = L_HKONT.                                  &nbs
** 금액                                         
*  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.                              &
** 지정                                         
*  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                                 &nbs
**  IF P_BUKRS = '1000'.                                  &n
***  IT_DOCL-GSBER = '10001'.                                  &n
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    IT_DOCL-GSBER = 'S110'.                                &nbs
**  ENDIF.                                       &

*  CLEAR : L_BANKL.

*                  WHERE BANKS = 'KR'                   
*                    AND BANKL = L_BANKL.                &nb
**  CONCATENATE  BNKA-BANKA '파워텍'                                 
**         INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.                       &nb
*  CONCATENATE '어음입금(당일자)' L_NAME1                                 &nb

*  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                  
**.....................................                                    
** 전표생성                                        &nb
*  GV_MODE = 'E'.                                    &n
*  CALL FUNCTION 'ZFB_PROCESS_00002100'                                &nbs
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      DOCH    = IT_DOCH                             &n
*      MODE    = GV_MODE                             &n
*    IMPORTING                                     
*      MESSAGE = G_MESSAGE_S                               &
*    TABLES                                     &n
*      DOCL    = IT_DOCL.                             &
*                                          &n
*  IF G_MESSAGE_S-MSGTY = 'S' AND G_MESSAGE_S-MSGNO = '312'.                         
*    G_BELNR = G_MESSAGE_S-MSGV1.                                
*    G_SUBRC = 0.                                  &nbs
*    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'                             &nb
*      EXPORTING                                   
*        INPUT  = G_BELNR                             &
*      IMPORTING                                   
*        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.                              
*                                          &n
*    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET BELNR      = G_BELNR                      &nb
*                         BUDAT      = IT_0102-TRNDT       &
*                   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR           &n
*                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE            &n
*                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE            &n
*                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE            &n
*                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.            &
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      COMMIT WORK.                                 &nb
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    G_SUBRC = 4.                                  &nbs
*    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.                                 &nb
*    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET MSGV1      = W_MSG                       
*                   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR           &n
*                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE            &n
*                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE            &n
*                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE            &n
*                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.            &
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      COMMIT WORK.                                 &nb
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

ENDFORM.                    " RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_BILL

*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0900  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0900 INPUT.

  DATA : SAVE_OK LIKE SY-UCOMM.

  SAVE_OK = OK_CODE.
  CLEAR OK_CODE.

  CASE SAVE_OK.
    WHEN 'UPLD'.
      PERFORM UPLOAD_DATA.
    WHEN '0700_OK'.
      PERFORM CREATE_DOCUMENT.
    WHEN '0700_CANC'.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0900  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  UPDATE_BILL_DATE                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM UPDATE_BILL_DATE .

  IF G_BILL_DATE <= G_BILL_TRIDT.
    UPDATE ZFBT102
       SET BILL_DATE = G_BILL_DATE
           TRIDT     = G_BILL_TRIDT
           MSGV1     = GS_BILL-TRIDT
     WHERE ZBUKR     = GS_BILL-ZBUKR
       AND BANK_CODE = GS_BILL-BANK_CODE
       AND ENTE_CODE = GS_BILL-ENTE_CODE
       AND SEND_DATE = GS_BILL-SEND_DATE
       AND DOCU_CODE = GS_BILL-DOCU_CODE
       AND UPMU_CODE = GS_BILL-UPMU_CODE
       AND DOCU_NUMC = GS_BILL-DOCU_NUMC
       AND TRNDT     = GS_BILL-TRNDT.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      GC_BILL = 'X'.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '할인가능가능일이 만기일보다 큽니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " UPDATE_BILL_DATE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CHANGE_BILL_DATE                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CHANGE_BILL_DATE .

  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '라인을 선택하여 주십시요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'
                    AND BELNR <> SPACE.
    LV_CHK = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
    MESSAGE I000
       WITH '입금전표가 생성된 건은'
            '할인가능일자를 변경 할 수 없습니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    CLEAR : GS_BILL, G_BILL_DATE, G_BILL_TRIDT.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_0102 TO GS_BILL.
    MOVE IT_0102-BILL_DATE TO G_BILL_DATE.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRIDT     TO G_BILL_TRIDT.

    CALL SCREEN '0900'  STARTING AT  30  012
                        ENDING   AT  100 020.

    IF GC_BILL = 'X'.
      MESSAGE S000 WITH '변경 되었습니다.'.
    ELSEIF GC_CANC = 'X'.
      MESSAGE S000 WITH '취소 되었습니다.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " CHANGE_BILL_DATE

FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_DISC .
*  DATA : LT_AR    LIKE ZFBS202 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                     &
*         LT_CLEAR LIKE ZFBS202 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                   &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA : BEGIN OF LT_DOCU OCCURS 0,                              
*           KUNNR     LIKE BSID-KUNNR,                      
*           BELNR     LIKE BSID-BELNR,                      
*           BUDAT     LIKE BSID-BUDAT,                      
*           GJAHR     LIKE BSID-GJAHR,                      
*           BANK_CODE LIKE ZFBT102-BANK_CODE,                        &
*           ENTE_CODE LIKE ZFBT102-ENTE_CODE,                        &
*           SEND_DATE LIKE ZFBT102-SEND_DATE,                        &
*           DOCU_CODE LIKE ZFBT102-DOCU_CODE,                        &
*           UPMU_CODE LIKE ZFBT102-UPMU_CODE,                        &
*           DOCU_NUMC LIKE ZFBT102-DOCU_NUMC,                        &
*         END OF LT_DOCU.                             &
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C.                                 
*  DATA : LV_HKONT   LIKE T012K-HKONT.                             &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LT_CUST LIKE ZFBT210 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                        
*  DATA : L_CNT   TYPE I.                               &nbs
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.                            
*  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.                                  
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '어음할인 대상을 선택하여 주십시요'.                           &nbs
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR LV_CHK.                                     &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'                              
*                    AND BELNR = SPACE.                 
*    LV_CHK = 'X'.                                  &nb
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.                                   &
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '입금전표가 처리되지 않은 건이 존재합니다.'.                          
*    EXIT.                                     &nb

**   어음할인(분할) 후                                    &nbs
**   최종수탁금액으로 할인반제처리(2011.11.21 BY ASANG)                              &nbs
*      G_DISC_AMT = G_DISC_AMT + IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.

*      APPEND LT_CUST. CLEAR LT_CUST.                             
*    ENDLOOP.                                     
*                                          &n

**    ELSE.                                     &n

**    ENDIF.                                     &

*  ENDIF.                                       &n
ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_DISC

*  CLEAR   : SELECTFIELD, IT_FIELDS, SELECT_VALUE, LD_TABIX.                         
*  REFRESH : IT_FIELDS.                                   &n
*                                          &n
** F4를 눌렀을때 보여지는 필드 선언.                                  &nb
*  DATA : LT_VALUE LIKE T012K OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                        
*                                          &n
*  DATA : BEGIN OF IT_VALUE OCCURS 0,                             &nbs

** 화면 필드 선언 -> 선택된 값을 화면 필드에 뿌려줄때 사용.                           &nb

*  CLEAR LT_VALUE. REFRESH LT_VALUE.                                &n

*    FROM T012K                                    
*   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS                                 &n
*     AND WAERS = 'KRW'.                                
*  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                   &
*    CLEAR IT_VALUE. REFRESH IT_VALUE.                              &n
*    LOOP AT LT_VALUE.                                  
*      MOVE-CORRESPONDING LT_VALUE TO IT_VALUE.                           &
*                                          &n
*      CLEAR T012T.                                 &nb
*      SELECT SINGLE *                                &
*               FROM T012T                         
*              WHERE SPRAS = SY-LANGU                      &
*                AND BUKRS = P_BUKRS                    &nbs
*                AND HBKID = LT_VALUE-HBKID                   &nb
*                AND HKTID = LT_VALUE-HKTID.                   &n
*      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                               &
*        MOVE T012T-TEXT1 TO IT_VALUE-TEXT1.                          
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*      APPEND IT_VALUE. CLEAR IT_VALUE.                            &nb
*    ENDLOOP.                                     
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
** 검색된 자료의 존재 여부.                                    &n
*  IF IT_VALUE[] IS INITIAL.                                 &nbs
*    MESSAGE I000 WITH '값이 없습니다.'.                              &
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
** F4를 눌렀을때 Hit List를 보여준다.                                  
*  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012K'.                                
*  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'BANKN'.                                 &nbs
*  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = 'X'. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시                           
*  APPEND IT_FIELDS.                                    &nbs
*  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012K'.                                
*  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'HKONT'.                                 &nbs
*  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = ' '. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시                          
*  APPEND IT_FIELDS.                                    &nbs
*  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012T'.                                
*  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'TEXT1'.                                 &nbs
*  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = ' '. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시                          
*  APPEND IT_FIELDS.                                    &nbs
*                                          &n
** F4기능 부분                                       &
*  CALL FUNCTION 'HELP_VALUES_GET_NO_DD_NAME'                               &nbs
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      SELECTFIELD                  = SELECTFIELD             &nb
*    IMPORTING                                     
*      IND                          = LD_TABIX       &n
*      SELECT_VALUE                 = SELECT_VALUE              &
*    TABLES                                     &n
*      FIELDS                       = IT_FIELDS         &nbs
*      FULL_TABLE                   = IT_VALUE             &
*    EXCEPTIONS                                    &nbs
*      FULL_TABLE_EMPTY             = 1                   &n
*      NO_TABLESTRUCTURE_GIVEN      = 2                         &
*      NO_TABLEFIELDS_IN_DICTIONARY = 3                             &n
*      MORE_THEN_ONE_SELECTFIELD    = 4                           
*      NO_SELECTFIELD               = 5                 &nbs
*      OTHERS                       = 6.           
*                                          &n
**  DOUBLE CLICK시 값을 화면에 DISPLAY                                &
*  CHECK NOT LD_TABIX IS INITIAL.                                
*  READ TABLE IT_VALUE INDEX LD_TABIX.                               &
*  P_VALUE      = IT_VALUE-BANKN.                             &nb
*                                          &n
** DESC을 바로 보여주기 위한 부분.                                  &nb
**      표시될 화면 필드명 과 값                              &nb
*                                          &n
*  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDNAME  = P_UBKNT. "반드시 대문자.                             &
*  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDVALUE = IT_VALUE-BANKN.                                &
*  APPEND SCR_FIELDS.                                    &nb
*  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDNAME  = P_TEXT. "반드시 대문자.                             &n
*  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDVALUE = IT_VALUE-TEXT1.                                &
*  APPEND SCR_FIELDS.                                    &nb
*                                          &n
*  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'                                 
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      DYNAME               = SY-CPROG                  
*      DYNUMB               = SY-DYNNR                  
*    TABLES                                     &n
*      DYNPFIELDS           = SCR_FIELDS                     
*    EXCEPTIONS                                    &nbs
*      INVALID_ABAPWORKAREA = 1                              &nbs
*      INVALID_DYNPROFIELD  = 2                              
*      INVALID_DYNPRONAME   = 3                             
*      INVALID_DYNPRONUMMER = 4                              &nbs
*      INVALID_REQUEST      = 5                          &nb
*      NO_FIELDDESCRIPTION  = 6                              
*      UNDEFIND_ERROR       = 7                         &nbs
*      OTHERS               = 8.                   
*                                          &n
*  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.                                  
*    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO                         &
*    WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.                            &
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

ENDFORM.                                                    " F4_UBKNT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CLEARING_DOCUMENT                              &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CLEARING_DOCUMENT .

  DATA : LV_CNT     TYPE I.
  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C.
  DATA : LV_FLAG(01) TYPE C.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE S006.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*  CLEAR LV_CNT.                                     &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.                              
*    LV_CNT = LV_CNT + 1.                               &nbs
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*  IF LV_CNT > 1.                                   
*    MESSAGE I000                                   &nb
*       WITH '한건씩 진행하여 주십시요.'.                             &
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'
                    AND ICON <> SPACE.
    LV_CHK = 'A'.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CHK = 'A'.
    LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'
                      AND ICON = SPACE.
      LV_CHK = 'X'.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
      MESSAGE S000
         WITH '자동처리 내역과 채권선택처리 내역을'
              '함께 지정 할 수 없습니다.'.
      EXIT.
    ELSE.
      IF LV_CHK <> 'A'.
        CLEAR LV_CNT.
        LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
          LV_CNT = LV_CNT + 1.
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
        ENDLOOP.
        IF LV_CNT > 1.
          MESSAGE I000
             WITH '한건씩 진행하여 주십시요.'.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK   = 'X'
                    AND BELNR <> SPACE.
    LV_CHK = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '이미 입금처리된 데이터 입니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR GS_AR.
  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    IF IT_0102-ICON <> SPACE.
      CLEAR G_ANSWER.
      PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
        USING '[확인]'
              '반제전표를 생성 하시겠습니까?'
              '' ''
     CHANGING G_ANSWER.
      CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.

      LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'
                        AND ICON <> SPACE.
        PERFORM AUTO_DOCUMENT.
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.

      MOVE : IT_0102-BANK_CODE1 TO GS_AR-BANK_CODE1,
             IT_0102-TRNDT      TO GS_AR-TRNDT,
             IT_0102-BILL_DATE  TO GS_AR-BILL_DATE,
             IT_0102-KUNNR      TO GS_AR-KUNNR,
             IT_0102-FNAME      TO GS_AR-FNAME,
             IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT TO GS_AR-TRAN_AMT,
             IT_0102-BELNR      TO GS_AR-BELNR.

      GS_AR-SUN_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT
                    + GS_AR-FEE_AMT.

      GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT.

      SELECT SINGLE TEXT
               INTO GS_AR-TEXT
               FROM ZFBT056
              WHERE BANK_CODE1 = GS_AR-BANK_CODE1.

      SELECT SINGLE NAME1
               INTO GS_AR-NAME1
               FROM KNA1
              WHERE KUNNR = GS_AR-KUNNR.

*-. 미결채권 추출                                       
      CLEAR   GT_AR.
      REFRESH GT_AR.
      LV_FLAG = 'D'.
* 대표업체코드 추출                                       
      PERFORM GET_REP_KUNNR USING IT_0102-KUNNR.

      SELECT *
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE GT_AR
        FROM BSID
       WHERE BUKRS   = P_BUKRS
         AND KUNNR  IN R_KUNNR
         AND UMSKZ   = SPACE
         AND BUDAT  =< SY-DATUM
         AND WAERS   = 'KRW'
         AND SHKZG   = 'S'
         AND ZLSPR   = SPACE.

      CLEAR GT_CLR. REFRESH GT_CLR.
      SELECT *
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE GT_CLR
        FROM BSID
       WHERE BUKRS   = P_BUKRS
         AND KUNNR  IN R_KUNNR
         AND UMSKZ   = SPACE
         AND BUDAT  <= SY-DATUM
         AND WAERS   = 'KRW'
         AND SHKZG   = 'H'
         AND ZLSPR   = SPACE.

      IF NOT GT_AR[] IS INITIAL.
        LOOP AT GT_AR.
          SELECT SINGLE NAME1
                   INTO GT_AR-NAME1
                   FROM KNA1
                  WHERE KUNNR = GT_AR-KUNNR.

          IF GT_AR-SHKZG = 'H'.
            GT_AR-SIGN = '-'.
          ENDIF.

          LOOP AT GT_CLR WHERE REBZG = GT_AR-BELNR
                           AND REBZJ = GT_AR-GJAHR.
            GT_AR-WRBTR = GT_AR-WRBTR - GT_CLR-WRBTR.
          ENDLOOP.

          GT_AR-TRAN_AMT = GT_AR-WRBTR * 100.

          MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX.
          CLEAR GT_AR.
        ENDLOOP.

        DATA : LT_AR  LIKE GT_AR OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
               LV_AMT LIKE BSEG-WRBTR.

        LT_AR[] = GT_AR[].
        SORT LT_AR BY BUDAT.

        SORT LT_AR BY BUDAT.
        LV_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT / 100.
        READ TABLE LT_AR WITH KEY WRBTR = LV_AMT.
        IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
          READ TABLE GT_AR WITH KEY BELNR = LT_AR-BELNR
                                    GJAHR = LT_AR-GJAHR
                                    BUDAT = LT_AR-BUDAT.
          IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
            GT_AR-MARK = '√'.
            GT_AR-P_WRBTR = GT_AR-WRBTR * 100.
            MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX. CLEAR GT_AR.
            PERFORM CALC_AMT.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          CLEAR LT_AR. REFRESH LT_AR.
          LOOP AT GT_AR.
            MOVE : GT_AR-GJAHR     TO LT_AR-GJAHR,
                   GT_AR-BELNR     TO LT_AR-BELNR,
                   GT_AR-KUNNR     TO LT_AR-KUNNR,
                   GT_AR-WRBTR     TO LT_AR-WRBTR.

            COLLECT LT_AR. CLEAR LT_AR.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        SORT LT_AR BY BUDAT.
        READ TABLE LT_AR WITH KEY WRBTR = LV_AMT.
        IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
          LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE GJAHR = LT_AR-GJAHR
                          AND BELNR = LT_AR-BELNR
                          AND BUDAT = LT_AR-BUDAT.
            GT_AR-MARK = '√'.
            GT_AR-P_WRBTR = GT_AR-WRBTR * 100.
            MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX. CLEAR GT_AR.
          ENDLOOP.
          PERFORM CALC_AMT.
        ENDIF.

        DESCRIBE TABLE GT_AR LINES TC-LINES.
        CLEAR OK_CODE.
        CALL SCREEN 0800.
      ELSE.
        MESSAGE S000
           WITH '처리 가능한 AR전표가 존재하지 않습니다.'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE S006.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " CLEARING_DOCUMENT
* AR반제관련 추가 ******************************************************

  SET PF-STATUS 'G0800'.
  SET TITLEBAR  'T0800'.

MODULE MODIFY_SCR OUTPUT.

ENDMODULE.                 " MODIFY_SCR  OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  MODIFY_SCREEN  OUTPUT                            
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE MODIFY_SCREEN OUTPUT.

  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF GT_AR-PART = 'X'.
      IF SCREEN-GROUP1 = 'GR1'.
        SCREEN-INTENSIFIED = '1'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF GT_AR-INVO = 'X'.
      IF SCREEN-NAME = 'GT_AR-ZUONRE'.
        SCREEN-INPUT = 1.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      IF SCREEN-NAME = 'GT_AR-ZUONRE'.
        SCREEN-INPUT = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF GT_AR-MARK = '√'.
      IF SCREEN-NAME = 'GT_AR-P_WRBTR'.
        SCREEN-INPUT = 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDMODULE.                 " MODIFY_SCREEN  OUTPUT

  MODIFY GT_AR INDEX TC-CURRENT_LINE.

MODULE CALC_GAMT INPUT.

  PERFORM CALC_AMT.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0800  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0800 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN 'PICK'.
      PERFORM DB_CLICK_0800.

    WHEN 'CLEAR'.
      PERFORM CREATE_CLEARING_DOCUMENT.

    WHEN 'CHK'.
      PERFORM SELECT_LINE_0800.

    WHEN 'GCHK'.
      IF G_GCHK = 'X'.
        CLEAR G_GCHK.
      ELSE.
        G_GCHK = '√'.
      ENDIF.
    WHEN 'SELA'.
      PERFORM SELECT_ALL_0800.

    WHEN 'DSEL'.
      PERFORM DESELECT_ALL_0800.

    WHEN 'SORA'.
      PERFORM SORT_UP_0800.

    WHEN 'SORD'.
      PERFORM SORT_DOWN_0800.

  ENDCASE.

  CLEAR OK_CODE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0800  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DB_CLICK_0800                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DB_CLICK_0800 .

  DATA : LV_CHAE_AMT   LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.

  DATA : LV_LINE TYPE I.
  DATA : LV_FIELD(50) TYPE C.

  CLEAR LV_FIELD.
  GET CURSOR FIELD LV_FIELD.
  IF LV_FIELD = 'GS_AR-BELNR'.
    CLEAR RF05L.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = GS_AR-BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = RF05L-BELNR.
    RF05L-BUKRS = P_BUKRS.
    RF05L-GJAHR = GS_AR-TRNDT(04).

    SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD RF05L-BELNR.
    SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD RF05L-BUKRS.
    SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD RF05L-GJAHR.
    CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
  ELSE.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " DB_CLICK_0800
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CREATE_CLEARING_DOCUMENT                             &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CREATE_CLEARING_DOCUMENT .

  IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT > 0.
    CLEAR G_ANSWER.
    PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
      USING '[확인]'
            '반제전표를 생성 하시겠습니까?'
            '' ''
   CHANGING G_ANSWER.
    CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.

* 분할금액 확인                                       &n
    LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE MARK = '√'.
      IF GT_AR-TRAN_AMT <> GT_AR-P_WRBTR.
        GT_AR-PART = 'X'.
        MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX. CLEAR GT_AR.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP_DOCU
      USING '[선수금/예수금처리]'
            '차이금액이 발생하였습니다.'
            '선수금 또는 예수금처리 버튼을 선택하여 주십시요.'
            'X' SPACE
   CHANGING G_ANSWER.
    CHECK G_ANSWER <> 'A'.
    PERFORM SUNSU_DOCUMENT.
  ELSEIF GS_AR-CHAE_AMT < 0.
    IF NOT GS_AR-GAMT IS INITIAL.
      G_GAMT = GS_AR-GAMT.
    ENDIF.
    PERFORM PARTIAL_DOCUMENT.
  ELSE.
    CLEAR G_ANSWER.
    PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
      USING '[확인]'
            '반제전표를 생성 하시겠습니까?'
            '' ''
   CHANGING G_ANSWER.
    CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.

    IF NOT GS_AR-GAMT IS INITIAL.
      G_GAMT = GS_AR-GAMT.
    ENDIF.

* 분할금액 확인                                       &n
    LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE MARK = '√'.
      IF GT_AR-TRAN_AMT <> GT_AR-P_WRBTR.
        GT_AR-PART = 'X'.
        MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX. CLEAR GT_AR.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    PERFORM EQUAL_DOCUMENT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " CREATE_CLEARING_DOCUMENT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SUNSU_DOCUMENT                               &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SUNSU_DOCUMENT .

*  DATA : LS_0106  LIKE ZFBT106.                               &n
  DATA : LV_NEWBS LIKE RF05A-NEWBS,
         LV_NEWKO LIKE RF05A-NEWKO,
         LV_NEWUM LIKE RF05A-NEWUM.

  DATA : LV_CNT     TYPE I.

  DATA : LV_INIT_DATE LIKE SY-DATUM VALUE IS INITIAL.

  DATA : L_TEXT(30) TYPE C.
  DATA : NUM16(16) TYPE N.
  DATA : L_TRAN_AMT TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_GAP_AMT  TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_FEE_AMT  TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_GJG_AMT  TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR.

  DATA : LV_HKONT        LIKE T012K-HKONT.

  CLEAR : L_TRAN_AMT, L_GAP_AMT.

  L_GAP_AMT  = NUM16 = GS_AR-SUN_AMT.
  L_FEE_AMT  = NUM16 = GS_AR-FEE_AMT.
  L_TEXT     = '펌뱅킹 원화 입금처리'.

  READ TABLE GT_AR WITH KEY MARK = '√'.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    LV_CHECK = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

  IF LV_CHECK = 'X' AND G_ANSWER = '2'.

            '선택된 경우에만 처리 가능합니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF NOT G_GAMT IS INITIAL..
    L_GJG_AMT = G_GAMT.
  ENDIF.

  IF NOT GS_AR-BILL_DATE IS INITIAL.
    LV_DATE = GS_AR-BILL_DATE.

  CLEAR LV_HKONT.

            AND HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID

   ' '  'BKPF-MONAT'   LV_DATE+4(02) ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-WAERS'   'KRW'                 ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-BKTXT'   L_TEXT                ,

    LV_NEWKO = '0021107999'.
    LV_NEWUM = SPACE.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR OK_CODE.

  CLEAR LV_SGTXT.
  CONCATENATE IT_0102-KUNNRM
              '받을어음'
              '('
              IT_0102-TEXT

* 수수료가 발생하였을 경우                                     &nb
  IF NOT GS_AR-FEE_AMT IS INITIAL.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '2320'         ,  "
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'          ,  "
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  "
     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   LV_DATE,
     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   LV_SGTXT       ,

     ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40'           ,  "
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  '0053302202'   .  "

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  "
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'          ,  "
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_FEE_AMT      ,  "
     ' '  'COBL-KOSTL'   G_FEE_KOSTL         ,
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  LV_NEWBS       ,
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  LV_NEWKO       ,
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWUM'  LV_NEWUM       .

    IF LV_CHECK = 'X'.
      IF G_ANSWER = '1'.
        PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
         'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0304'         ,  "
         ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=BU'          ,  "
         ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_GAP_AMT      ,  "
         ' '  'BSEG-MWSKZ'   'PP'.
*         ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   '선수금 처리'.                      &nbs
      ELSE.

  ELSE.

     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  "
     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   LV_DATE,

    IF LV_CHECK = 'X'.

         ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_GAP_AMT      ,  "
         ' '  'BSEG-MWSKZ'   'PP'.

      ELSE.

    ELSE.

        PERFORM DYNPRO USING :

         ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_GAP_AMT      ,  "

      ELSE.

         ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   '예수금 처리'.

    ENDIF.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0710'       , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGBUK'      P_BUKRS      , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGKON'      ' ', "

  LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE MARK = '√'.     "매출채권
    CONCATENATE GT_AR-BELNR GT_AR-GJAHR GT_AR-BUZEI INTO SEL01.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0733'       , "

       ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  SEL01, "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'        . "

    IF GT_AR-P_WRBTR = GT_AR-TRAN_AMT.
      LOOP AT GT_CLR WHERE REBZG = GT_AR-BELNR
                       AND REBZJ = GT_AR-GJAHR.
        CONCATENATE GT_CLR-BELNR
                    GT_CLR-GJAHR
                    GT_CLR-BUZEI INTO SEL01.
        PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
           'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0733'       , "
           ' '   'RF05A-FELDN(01)'  'BELNR',
           ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  SEL01, "
           ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'        . "
      ENDLOOP.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0733'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PA'        . "

       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=OMX'       . "

       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=Z+'        . "

  LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE PART = 'X'.
    CLEAR L_GAP_AMT.

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
         'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
         ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PART'      . "

         'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
         ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=OSU'       .

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
         'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '2000'       , "
         ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'        , "
         ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(03)'  'X'.

         'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '0731'        , "
         ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'         , "
         ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  GT_AR-BELNR.

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
         'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , "
         ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'         , "
         ' '   'DF05B-PSZAH(01)'  L_GAP_AMT .

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
         'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , "

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , " "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=BU'         . "

  PERFORM CALL_TRANS USING 'F-04' 'E'.

  READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                              MSGNR  = '312'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    G_BELNR = MESSTAB-MSGV1.

    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = G_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.

    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR      = G_BELNR
                        BUDAT      = LV_DATE
                        GJAHR      = LV_DATE(04)
                   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                     AND PART_SEQ  = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      CLEAR G_BELNR.

      MESSAGE S000 WITH '정상 처리 되었습니다.'.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'E'.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'
        EXPORTING
          MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID
          MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR
          MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1
          MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2

          MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4
        IMPORTING

      MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
    ELSE.

          EXPORTING
            MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID
            MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR
            MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1

ENDFORM.                    " SUNSU_DOCUMENT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SELECT_LINE_0800                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

FORM SELECT_LINE_0800 .

  DATA : LV_CNT  TYPE I.
  DATA : LV_LINE TYPE I.

  CLEAR LV_LINE.
  GET CURSOR LINE  LV_LINE.
  LV_LINE = TC-TOP_LINE + LV_LINE - 1.

  READ TABLE GT_AR INDEX LV_LINE.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    IF GT_AR-MARK = '√'.
      CLEAR : GT_AR-MARK, GT_AR-PART, GT_AR-INVO.

      GS_AR-AR_AMT = GS_AR-AR_AMT - GT_AR-P_WRBTR. "GT_AR-TRAN_AMT.

      GS_AR-SUN_AMT = ( GS_AR-TRAN_AMT - GS_AR-GAMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT )
                    - GS_AR-AR_AMT.
      IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.
        CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.
      ENDIF.

      GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = ( GS_AR-TRAN_AMT + GS_AR-GAMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT )
                     - GS_AR-AR_AMT.

      CLEAR GT_AR-P_WRBTR.
*      GS_AR-SUN_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT                             &nbs
*                    - GS_AR-AR_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT               
*                    + GS_AR-GAMT.                   &n
*      IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.                              
*        CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.                              &
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*      GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT                             &nb
*                     - GS_AR-AR_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT              
*                     - GS_AR-GAMT.                  &n
    ELSE.
*      IF GT_AR-TRAN_AMT >= GS_AR-TRAN_AMT.                           &n
*        CLEAR LV_CNT.                               &n
*        LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE MARK = '√'                        &n
*                        AND TRAN_AMT >= GS_AR-TRAN_AMT.          &
*          LV_CNT = LV_CNT + 1.                         &nbs
*        ENDLOOP.                                 
*                                          &n
*        IF LV_CNT > 0.                             
*          MESSAGE I000                             &nb
*             WITH '입금액 보다 큰 미결항목을'                      &nb
*                  '한건 이상 선택 할 수 없습니다.'.                &nbs
*          EXIT.                               &nb
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
      DATA : LV_CHAE_AMT LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.
      CLEAR LV_CHAE_AMT.
      LV_CHAE_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT + GS_AR-CHAE_AMT .

*      IF LV_CHAE_AMT < GS_AR-AR_AMT.                            &n
*        MESSAGE I000                               &nb
*           WITH '차이금액 보다 큰 미결항목을'                        &n
*                '선택 할 수 없습니다.'.                     &n
*        EXIT.                                 &nb
*      ENDIF.                                   &n

      GT_AR-MARK = '√'.
      GT_AR-INVO = 'X'.
      GT_AR-P_WRBTR = GT_AR-TRAN_AMT.

      GS_AR-AR_AMT = GS_AR-AR_AMT + GT_AR-P_WRBTR. "GT_AR-TRAN_AMT.

      GS_AR-SUN_AMT = ( GS_AR-TRAN_AMT - GS_AR-GAMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT )
                    - GS_AR-AR_AMT.
      IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.
        CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.
      ENDIF.

      GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = ( GS_AR-TRAN_AMT + GS_AR-GAMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT )
                     - GS_AR-AR_AMT.

*      GS_AR-SUN_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT                             &nbs
*                    - GS_AR-AR_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT.              &nbs
*      IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.                              
*        CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.                              &
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*      GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT                             &nb
*                     - GS_AR-AR_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT.             &nbs
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " SELECT_LINE_0800
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SELECT_ALL_0800                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SELECT_ALL_0800 .

  CHECK GV_SELA = SPACE.

  GV_SELA = 'X'.

  LOOP AT GT_AR.
    GT_AR-MARK = '√'.
    GS_AR-AR_AMT = GS_AR-AR_AMT + GT_AR-TRAN_AMT.
    MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX.
  ENDLOOP.
  GS_AR-SUN_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT - GS_AR-AR_AMT.
  IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.
    CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.
  ENDIF.

  GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT - GS_AR-AR_AMT.

ENDFORM.                    " SELECT_ALL_0800
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DESELECT_ALL_0800                              &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DESELECT_ALL_0800 .

  CLEAR : GS_AR-AR_AMT, GV_SELA.

  LOOP AT GT_AR.
    CLEAR GT_AR-MARK.
    MODIFY GT_AR INDEX SY-TABIX.
  ENDLOOP.
  GS_AR-SUN_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT.
  IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.
    CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.
  ENDIF.

  GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT - GS_AR-AR_AMT.

ENDFORM.                    " DESELECT_ALL_0800

FORM SORT_UP_0800 .

  DATA : LV_FIELD(20) TYPE C.

  CLEAR LV_FIELD.
  GET CURSOR FIELD LV_FIELD.

      LV_FIELD = LV_FIELD+06(14).
      SORT GT_AR BY (LV_FIELD).
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " SORT_UP_0800

*&      Form  PARTIAL_DOCUMENT                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

FORM PARTIAL_DOCUMENT .

*  DATA : LS_0106    LIKE ZFBT106.                             &n
  DATA : LV_CNT     TYPE I.

  DATA : L_TEXT(30) TYPE C.
  DATA : NUM16(16) TYPE N.
  DATA : L_TRAN_AMT    TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_GAP_AMT(15) TYPE C,
         L_FEE_AMT     TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,
         L_GJG_AMT     TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR.

  DATA : LV_HKONT        LIKE T012K-HKONT.
  DATA : SEL01           LIKE RF05A-SEL01.
  DATA : LV_KUNNR        LIKE KNA1-KUNNR.

  CLEAR   : BDC_TAB, MESSTAB, G_BELNR.
  REFRESH : BDC_TAB, MESSTAB.

  CLEAR : L_TRAN_AMT, L_GAP_AMT.
  L_TRAN_AMT = GS_AR-TRAN_AMT.

  READ TABLE GT_AR WITH KEY PART = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    IF NOT G_GAMT IS INITIAL..
      L_GJG_AMT = G_GAMT.
    ENDIF.

    L_GAP_AMT  = GT_AR-TRAN_AMT - ( GS_AR-CHAE_AMT * -1 ).

    CONDENSE L_GAP_AMT NO-GAPS.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE I000
       WITH '분할대상을 선택하여 주십시요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR G_ANSWER.
  PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
    USING '[확인]'
          '반제전표를 생성 하시겠습니까?'
          '' ''
 CHANGING G_ANSWER.
  CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.

  L_FEE_AMT  = GS_AR-FEE_AMT.
  L_TEXT     = '펌뱅킹 입금처리'.

  CLEAR LV_HKONT.
  SELECT SINGLE HKONT
           INTO LV_HKONT
           FROM T012K
          WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
            AND HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID
            AND HKTID = IT_0102-HKTID.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
   'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0122'                ,  "
   ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'                 ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-BLDAT'   GS_AR-BILL_DATE       ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-BLART'   'DZ'                  ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-BUKRS'   P_BUKRS               , "
   ' '  'BKPF-BUDAT'   GS_AR-BILL_DATE       ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-MONAT'   GS_AR-BILL_DATE+4(02) ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-WAERS'   'KRW'                 ,  "
   ' '  'BKPF-BKTXT'   L_TEXT                ,
   ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40'                  ,  "
   ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  LV_HKONT              .  "

* 수수료가 발생하였을 경우                                     &nb
  IF NOT GS_AR-FEE_AMT IS INITIAL.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  "
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'          ,  "
     ' '  'COBL-KOSTL'   'N60221'       ,
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  "
     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   '원화 AR반제처리',
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40'           ,
     ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  '0053302202'   .

    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  "
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=SL'          ,  "
     ' '  'COBL-KOSTL'   '1004'         ,
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_FEE_AMT      .  "
  ELSE.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  "
     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=SL'          ,  "
     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,
     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   '원화 AR반제처리'.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0710'       , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGBUK'      P_BUKRS      , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGKON'      ''           , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGKOA'      'D'          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-AGUMS'      ' '          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XNOPS'      'X'          , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(02)'  'X'          , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/05'        . "

  LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE MARK = '√'.     "매출채권
    CONCATENATE GT_AR-BELNR GT_AR-GJAHR GT_AR-BUZEI INTO SEL01.
    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0733'       , "
       ' '   'RF05A-FELDN(01)'  'BELNR',
       ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  SEL01, "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'        . "
  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0733'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PA'        . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=OMX'       . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=Z+'        . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PART'      . "

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=OSU'       .

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '2000'       , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'        , "
       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(03)'  'X'.

  READ TABLE GT_AR WITH KEY PART = 'X'.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '0731'        , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'         , "
       ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  GT_AR-BELNR.

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'         , "
       ' '   'DF05B-PSZAH(01)'  L_GAP_AMT     .

  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :
       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , " "
       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=BU'         . "

  PERFORM CALL_TRANS USING 'F-04' 'A'.

  READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                              MSGNR  = '312'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    G_BELNR = MESSTAB-MSGV1.

    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = G_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.

    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR      = G_BELNR
                        BUDAT      = GS_AR-BILL_DATE
                   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                     AND PART_SEQ  = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      CLEAR G_BELNR.

      MESSAGE S000 WITH '정상 처리 되었습니다.'.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'E'.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'
        EXPORTING
          MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID
          MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR
          MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1
          MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2
          MSGV3               = MESSTAB-MSGV3
          MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4
        IMPORTING
          MESSAGE_TEXT_OUTPUT = W_MSG.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
    ELSE.
      READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'
          EXPORTING
            MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID
            MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR
            MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1
            MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2
            MSGV3               = MESSTAB-MSGV3
            MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4
          IMPORTING
            MESSAGE_TEXT_OUTPUT = W_MSG.
        MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

ENDFORM.                    " PARTIAL_DOCUMENT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CALC_AMT                                &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CALC_AMT .

  CLEAR GS_AR-AR_AMT.
  LOOP AT GT_AR WHERE MARK = '√'.
    GS_AR-AR_AMT = GS_AR-AR_AMT + GT_AR-P_WRBTR.
  ENDLOOP.

  GS_AR-SUN_AMT = ( GS_AR-TRAN_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT )
                - GS_AR-AR_AMT - GS_AR-JE_AMT + GS_AR-JS_AMT.
  IF GS_AR-SUN_AMT < 0.
    CLEAR GS_AR-SUN_AMT.
  ENDIF.

  GS_AR-CHAE_AMT = ( GS_AR-TRAN_AMT + GS_AR-FEE_AMT
                   - GS_AR-JE_AMT   + GS_AR-JS_AMT )
                   - GS_AR-AR_AMT.

  CHECK OK_CODE = 'CLEAR'.

  IF GS_AR-CHAE_AMT < 0.
    MESSAGE I000
       WITH '차이금액이 "0.00"보다 작습니다.'
            '처리금액을 확인하여 주시기 바랍니다.'.
    CLEAR OK_CODE.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " CALC_AMT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_5034   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_5035   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_SPACE  text                               &nb
*      -->P_SPACE  text                               &nb
*      <--P_G_ANSWER  text                               
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CONFIRM_POPUP_DOCU  USING P_TITLE P_TEXT P_TEXT2 P_CANC P_TYPE
                      CHANGING P_ANSWER.

  DATA : LV_TEXT(100) TYPE C.

  CONCATENATE P_TEXT P_TEXT2
         INTO LV_TEXT.
  CONDENSE LV_TEXT.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      TITLEBAR              = P_TITLE
      TEXT_QUESTION         = LV_TEXT
      TEXT_BUTTON_1         = '선수금처리'
      ICON_BUTTON_1         = ' '
      TEXT_BUTTON_2         = '예수금처리'
      ICON_BUTTON_2         = ' '
      DEFAULT_BUTTON        = '2'
      DISPLAY_CANCEL_BUTTON = P_CANC
      START_COLUMN          = 25
      START_ROW             = 6
      POPUP_TYPE            = P_TYPE
    IMPORTING
      ANSWER                = P_ANSWER
    EXCEPTIONS
      TEXT_NOT_FOUND        = 1
      OTHERS                = 2.

ENDFORM.                    " CONFIRM_POPUP_DOCU

*&      Form  SET_FEE_AMT                               &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SET_FEE_AMT .

  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE S006.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    IF IT_0102-BELNR_B <> SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000
         WITH '전표가 생성된 건은 변경 할 수 없습니다.'.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR : GS_FDATA, G_FEE_AMT.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_0102 TO GS_FDATA.
      MOVE IT_0102-FEE_AMT       TO G_FEE_AMT.
      MOVE IT_0102-BANK_CODE     TO G_BANK.
      MOVE IT_0102-TEXT          TO G_BANK_NAME.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRNDT         TO G_TRNDT.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRNNO         TO G_TRNNO.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRAN_AMT      TO G_TRAN_AMT.
      MOVE IT_0102-FNAME         TO G_FNAME.

      SELECT SINGLE TEXT
               INTO GS_FDATA-TEXT
               FROM ZFBT056
              WHERE BANK_CODE1 = GS_FDATA-BANK_CODE1.

      CALL SCREEN 0400 STARTING AT 20 10
                       ENDING   AT 80 15.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " SET_FEE_AMT

MODULE USER_COMMAND_0400 INPUT.
