*  CLEAR ZFBT020.                                     &
*  SELECT SINGLE *                                    &
*    FROM ZFBT020                                   &nb
*   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR                           &n
*     AND BANK_CODE1 = IT_0102-BANK_CODE1                             
*     AND (LV_CHAR).                                  &
*                                          &n
*  SELECT SINGLE HKONT BANKN                                 &nbs
*           INTO (L_HKONT,L_BANKN)                           
*           FROM T012K                             
*          WHERE BUKRS = ZFBT020-ZBUKR                         &n
*            AND HBKID = ZFBT020-HBKID                       &nbs
*            AND HKTID = ZFBT020-HKTID.                       &nb
** 계정                                         
*  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = L_HKONT.                                  &nbs
** 금액                                         
*  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT                              
*                        - G_FEE_AMT               &nbs
*                        - G_IBK_FEE1               &nb
*                        - G_IBK_FEE2.               &n
** 지정                                         
*  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-TRNDT.                                 &nbs
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*  CLEAR : LV_LEN, LV_TEXT.                                  
*  CONCATENATE IT_0102-KUNNRM      '/'                            &nbs
*              '어음할인입금'                           
*         INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT.                             &n
*  CONDENSE IT_DOCL-SGTXT NO-GAPS.                                 &nb
*  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                  
**.....................................                                    
*  IF NOT G_FEE_AMT IS INITIAL.                                &n
*    IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형                      &nb
*    IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키                       &nb
** 계정                                         
*    IT_DOCL-NEWKO = '0063011060'.                                
** 금액                                         
*    IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = G_FEE_AMT.                             &n
** 지정                                         
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                               &nbs
*    IT_DOCL-KOSTL = GV_KOSTL.                                &nb
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*    CLEAR : LV_LEN, LV_TEXT.                                
*    CONCATENATE IT_0102-KUNNRM      '/'                          &nbs
*                '이자비용'                         &n
*           INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT.                           &n
*    CONDENSE IT_DOCL-SGTXT NO-GAPS.                               &nb
*    APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
**.....................................                                    
*  IF NOT G_IBK_FEE1 IS INITIAL.                                &
*    IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형                      &nb
*    IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키                       &nb
** 계정                                         
*    IT_DOCL-NEWKO = '0053701030'.                                
** 금액                                         
*    IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = G_IBK_FEE1.                             &
*    IT_DOCL-KOSTL = GV_KOSTL.                                &nb
** 지정                                         
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                               &nbs
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*    CLEAR : LV_LEN, LV_TEXT.                                
*    CONCATENATE IT_0102-KUNNRM      '/'                          &nbs
*                '할인수수료'                         &
*           INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT.                           &n
*    CONDENSE IT_DOCL-SGTXT NO-GAPS.                               &nb
*    APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
**.....................................                                    
*  IF NOT G_IBK_FEE2 IS INITIAL.                                &
*    IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형                      &nb
*    IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키                       &nb
** 계정                                         
*    IT_DOCL-NEWKO = '0053701030'.                                
** 금액                                         
*    IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = G_IBK_FEE2.                             &
*    IT_DOCL-KOSTL = GV_KOSTL.                                &nb
** 지정                                         
*    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.                               &nbs
** 아이템TEXT                                        
*    CLEAR : LV_LEN, LV_TEXT.                                
*    CONCATENATE IT_0102-KUNNRM      '/'                          &nbs
*                '전자어음수수료'                         
*           INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT.                           &n
*    CONDENSE IT_DOCL-SGTXT NO-GAPS.                               &nb
*    APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.                                
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
**.....................................                                    
** 전표생성                                        &nb
*  GV_MODE = 'A'.  "'N'.                                 &nb
*  CALL FUNCTION 'ZFB_PROCESS_00002100'                                &nbs
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      DOCH    = IT_DOCH                             &n
*      MODE    = GV_MODE                             &n
*    IMPORTING                                     
*      MESSAGE = G_MESSAGE_S                               &
*    TABLES                                     &n
*      DOCL    = IT_DOCL.                             &
*                                          &n
*  IF G_MESSAGE_S-MSGTY = 'S' AND G_MESSAGE_S-MSGNO = '312'.                         
*    G_BELNR = G_MESSAGE_S-MSGV1.                                
*    G_SUBRC = 0.                                  &nbs
*    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'                             &nb
*      EXPORTING                                   
*        INPUT  = G_BELNR                             &
*      IMPORTING                                   
*        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.                              
*    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET BELNR_A     = G_BELNR                       &
*                        BUDAT_A     = G_BUDAT          
*                        FEE_AMT     = G_FEE_AMT         &nb
*                        IBK_FEE1    = G_IBK_FEE1          &
*                        IBK_FEE2    = G_IBK_FEE2          &
*                        ZLIFNR2     = G_ZLIFNR2         &nb
*                   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR           &n
*                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE            &n
*                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE            &n
*                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE            &n
*                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC            &n
*                     AND TRNDT      = IT_0102-TRNDT         &nbs
*                     AND PART_SEQ   = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.           &nb
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      COMMIT WORK.                                 &nb
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    G_SUBRC = 4.                                  &nbs
*    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.                                 &nb
*    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET MSGV1      = W_MSG                       
*                   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR           &n
*                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE            &n
*                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE            &n
*                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE            &n
*                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC            &n
*                     AND TRNDT      = IT_0102-TRNDT         &nbs
*                     AND PART_SEQ   = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.           &nb
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      COMMIT WORK.                                 &nb
*      MESSAGE W_MSG TYPE 'S'.                              
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

ENDFORM.                    " RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION1
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

MODULE STATUS_0810 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS '0810'.
  SET TITLEBAR  '0810'.
ENDMODULE.                 " STATUS_0810  OUTPUT

*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0810  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0810 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0810_OK'.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
    WHEN '0810_CN'.
      CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0810  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION2                             &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION2 .

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK   = 'X'.
    CLEAR G_INPUT_AMT.
    IF IT_0102-BELNR_B NE SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '이미 전표처리가 완료되었습니다.'.
      EXIT.
    ELSEIF IT_0102-BELNR = SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '입금전표 처리후 작업이 가능합니다.'.
      EXIT.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR ZFBT102.
      SELECT SINGLE *
               FROM ZFBT102
              WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO.
*                AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.                    &nb
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
*        IF IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT NE IT_0102-EXP_AMT.                         
*          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.                         &
*          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST2.                         &n
*        ELSE.                                 &nb
*          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.                         &
*          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.                         &nb
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
        IF IT_0102-TRAN_AMT NE IT_0102-EXP_AMT.
          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
        ELSE.
          G_INPUT_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
          PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST2                             
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION_POST2 .

  DATA : L_BANKN     LIKE T012K-BANKN,
         L_HKONT     LIKE T012K-HKONT,
         L_BANKL     LIKE T012-BANKL,
         L_MSGV1     LIKE ZFBT102-MSGV1,
         L_NAME1     LIKE KNA1-NAME1,
         LV_CHAR(30).

  DATA : BEGIN OF LT_0102 OCCURS 0,
           BELNR_B LIKE ZFBT102-BELNR_B,
         END OF LT_0102.

  CLEAR : G_DISC_AMT, GS_0102.
  CLEAR LT_0102. REFRESH LT_0102.
  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_0102
    FROM ZFBT102
   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
     AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO
     AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.

  REFRESH : IT_DOCL.
  CLEAR   : IT_DOCH,IT_DOCL.
*........................................                                   &nbs
  IF IT_0102-TRDCD = 'MIGDATA' OR IT_0102-EXP_AMT = 0.
    IT_0102-RECE_DATE = G_BUDAT.
  ELSE.
  ENDIF.
  IT_DOCH-TCODE = 'FB05'.            "TCODE
  IT_DOCH-BLDAT = G_BUDAT.           "증빙일
  IT_DOCH-BLART = 'Z1'.              "전표유형
  IT_DOCH-BUDAT = G_BUDAT.           "전기일(현금입금일)
  IT_DOCH-BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR.     "회사코드
  IT_DOCH-WAERS = 'KRW'.
  IT_DOCH-BKTXT = '펌뱅킹 할인만기처리'.
  IT_DOCH-AUGLV = 'EINGZAHL'.
*                  AUSGZAHL = 지급                    &nb
*                  EINGZAHL = 입금                    &nb
*                  GUTSCHRI = 대변 메모                   &
*                  UMBUCHNG = 반제하여 대체전기                  &nb
*........................................                                   &nbs

  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형
  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키

  CASE IT_0102-BILL_CLASS.
    WHEN '10'. LV_CHAR = `IPGU_ACCT1 = 'X'`.
    WHEN '20'. LV_CHAR = `IPGU_ACCT2 = 'X'`.
    WHEN '30'. LV_CHAR = `IPGU_ACCT3 = 'X'`.
  ENDCASE.
  CLEAR ZFBT020.
  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM ZFBT020
   WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
     AND BANK_CODE1 = IT_0102-BANK_CODE1
     AND (LV_CHAR).

  SELECT SINGLE HKONT BANKN
           INTO (L_HKONT,L_BANKN)
           FROM T012K
          WHERE BUKRS = ZFBT020-ZBUKR
            AND HBKID = ZFBT020-HBKID
            AND HKTID = ZFBT020-HKTID.

  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = L_HKONT.
  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16
                = G_INPUT_AMT - G_DISC_AMT - G_FEE_AMT.
* 지정                                         
  IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.
* 아이템TEXT                                        &
  CLEAR L_NAME1.
  SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO L_NAME1
                     WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.
  CONCATENATE '어음만기입금전표' L_NAME1
        INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.

  IF G_FEE_AMT IS NOT INITIAL.
    IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형
    IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키
    IT_DOCL-NEWKO = C_HKONT_FEE2.
    IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = G_FEE_AMT.
    IT_DOCL-KOSTL = GV_KOSTL.
    IT_DOCL-ZUONR = IT_0102-BILNU.
    SELECT SINGLE NAME1
              INTO L_NAME1
              FROM KNA1
             WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.
    CONCATENATE '할인만기처리' L_NAME1
          INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
    APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.
  ENDIF.

*.........................................                                   &nb
*구매카드                                         &nbs
  CLEAR IT_CLEAR. REFRESH IT_CLEAR.
  IT_CLEAR-AGKOA  = 'D'    .       "계정유형
  IT_CLEAR-AGKON  = IT_0102-KUNNR. "계정번호 또는 작업리스트키
  IT_CLEAR-AGBUK  = IT_0102-ZBUKR. "회사코드
  IT_CLEAR-XNOPS  = ' '     .
  "지시자: 특별 G/L이 아닌 미결항목만 선택합니까?
  IT_CLEAR-XFIFO  = ''     ."지시자: 만기일에 따라 자동으로 배부
  IT_CLEAR-AGUMS  = 'W'    ."선택할 특별 G/L지시자
  IT_CLEAR-AVSID  = ''     ."지급통지서번호
  IT_CLEAR-SELFD  = 'BELNR'."전표인덱스의 필드이름
  IT_CLEAR-SELVON = IT_0102-BELNR.
  "미결항목선택에 대한 탐색기준의 입력필드 시작
  IT_CLEAR-SELBIS = ''     ."미결항목선택에 대한 탐색기준
  APPEND IT_CLEAR.CLEAR IT_CLEAR.

  LOOP AT LT_0102.
    IT_CLEAR-AGKOA  = 'D'    .       "
    IT_CLEAR-AGKON  = IT_0102-KUNNR. "
    IT_CLEAR-AGBUK  = IT_0102-ZBUKR. "
    IT_CLEAR-XNOPS  = ' '     .
    IT_CLEAR-XFIFO  = ''     ."
    IT_CLEAR-AGUMS  = 'W'    ."
    IT_CLEAR-AVSID  = ''     ."
    IT_CLEAR-SELFD  = 'BELNR'."
    IT_CLEAR-SELVON = LT_0102-BELNR_B.
    IT_CLEAR-SELBIS = ''     ."
    APPEND IT_CLEAR.CLEAR IT_CLEAR.
  ENDLOOP.

*.....................................                                    &
* 전표생성                                        &nbs
  GV_MODE = 'E'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'ZFB_PROCESS_00002100 '
    EXPORTING
      DOCH    = IT_DOCH
      MODE    = GV_MODE
    IMPORTING
      MESSAGE = G_MESSAGE_S
    TABLES
      DOCL    = IT_DOCL
      CLEAR   = IT_CLEAR.

  IF G_MESSAGE_S-MSGTY = 'S' AND G_MESSAGE_S-MSGNO = '312'.
    G_BELNR = G_MESSAGE_S-MSGV1.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = G_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.
    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR_B   = G_BELNR
                       BUDAT_B   = IT_0102-TRIDT
                 WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                   AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                   AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                   AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                   AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                   AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET MSGV1     = W_MSG
                 WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                   AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                   AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                   AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                   AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                   AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.

*& Form VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_CREA                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCU_CREA .


  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I006. EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR GV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    IF IT_0102-BELNR NE SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000
         WITH '이미 전표 처리된 데이터가 존재합니다.'.
      GV_CHK = 'X'. EXIT.
    ENDIF.
    IF IT_0102-KUNNR = SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000
         WITH '고객코드가 입력되지 않았습니다.'
              '데이터를 확인하세요.'.
      GV_CHK = 'X'. EXIT.
    ENDIF.
    IF IT_0102-TRDIV = '10' OR IT_0102-TRDIV = '20'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE I000
         WITH '전표처리 불가한 발행구분 상태 입니다.'
              '데이터를 확인하세요.'.
      GV_CHK = 'X'. EXIT.
    ENDIF.
    IF SY-SYSID = C_SYSID_PRD AND IT_0102-TRNDT < C_OPNDT.
      MESSAGE I999. GV_CHK = 'X'. EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  CHECK GV_CHK = SPACE.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    PERFORM RECE_PROCESS_DOCU_CREA.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
